Despite sharing the same primary coordination environment, the [Fe4S4] cofactors within Fds and HiPIPs operate with discrete redox couples and potential windows that afford distinct electrochemical properties depending on the Fe–S secondary coordination sphere and protein environment. This enables [Fe4S4] clusters to serve as versatile coupling partners for kinetically challenging redox reactions spanning the full range of biologically accessible reduction potentials. The electrochemical properties of [Fe4S4] clusters are tuned through the cooperative interplay between its strongly-correlated electronic structure and the noncovalent interactions within its secondary-sphere and protein environments. Significant experimental and computational efforts have been made to identify the structure-function relationships driving selective modulation of cluster electrochemical features; however, disentangling this complex interplay remains a significant challenge. Here, we employ a low-scaling, multi-reference computational approach to elucidate how secondary-sphere interactions, namely hydrogen bonding (H-bonding) and solvent electrostatics, tune the electronic structure of biomimetic [Fe4S4] clusters and give rise to the diverging redox properties observed across different protein scaffolds in biological systems.
items.authors: Shelby T. Davis, Jan-Niklas Boyn
items.title_zh: 阐明生物仿制铁硫立方体的次级配位球效应
items.summary_zh: 自然界利用铁硫（Fe–S）簇执行多种重要生物过程，包括长程电子传输和催化动力学挑战的氧化还原反应。Fe–S 立方体（[Fe4S4]）的结构高度保守，配体与四个半胱氨酸残基的配位将辅因子固定在如铁氧还蛋白（Fds）和高电位铁硫蛋白（HiPIPs）等金属蛋白中。尽管具有相同的主要配位环境，但Fds和HiPIPs中的[Fe4S4]辅因子展现出不同的氧化还原对和电位窗口，导致其电化学特性因Fe–S次级配位球和蛋白环境而异。这使得[Fe4S4]簇能够作为多功能耦合伙伴，参与全范围的生物可及还原电位的动力学挑战性氧化还原反应。通过次级配位球和蛋白环境中的非共价相互作用与其强相关的电子结构之间的协同作用，调节[Fe4S4]簇的电化学特性。

items.title: NanoFTIR spectroscopy probes solvation electrostatics in nanoconfinement
items.abstract: The structure and electrostatics of liquids change dramatically under nanometric confinement, suggesting that solvent-solute interactions in such environments differ fundamentally from those in the bulk. Here, we combine nanoscale Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (nanoFTIR) with the vibrational Stark effect (VSE) to directly map the local electric field experienced by a molecular probe—the C=O stretching vibration of dimethylformamide (DMF)—within buried nanofluidic channels. To this end, we fabricated hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-capped trenches with depths ranging from ~100 nm down to 2.6 nm and filled them with a 1:1 (v/v) aqueous DMF solution. Under the strongest confinement (2.6 nm), the DMF C=O stretching mode exhibits a +17 cm -1 blueshift, corresponding to a substantial change in the local solvation electric field strength of 0.39 V Å -1 . Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, combined with MD-derived IR spectra, reproduce the observed spectral shift and the associated change in local solvation electrostatics. The simulations further reveal the emergence of a quasi-phase-separated interfacial layer under finite-size confinement as the origin for the altered electrostatics. Together, these results establish nanoFTIR-based VSE spectroscopy as a direct and quantitative probe of nanosolvation electrostatics in nanoscale fluidic reactors.
items.authors: Leonard Pfister, Sviatoslav Kovalchuk, Oguzhan Yüzel, Kirill Bolotin, Joachim Heberle, Jacek Kozuch
items.title_zh: 纳米FTIR光谱探测纳米限制中的溶剂电场
items.summary_zh: 液体在纳米尺度限制下的结构和电场发生显著变化，表明此环境中的溶剂-溶质相互作用与体相中根本不同。本研究结合纳米级傅里叶变换红外光谱（nanoFTIR）与振动斯塔克效应（VSE），直接映射埋藏纳米流体通道中分子探针（N,N-二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的C=O伸缩振动）所经历的局部电场。我们制造了深度从约100纳米到2.6纳米的六方氮化硼（hBN）封闭沟槽，并填充1:1（v/v）的水性DMF溶液。在最强限制（2.6纳米）下，DMF的C=O伸缩模式表现出+17 cm⁻¹的蓝移，对应局部溶剂电场强度的显著变化（0.39 V Å⁻¹）。分子动力学（MD）模拟及其衍生的红外光谱再现了观察到的光谱偏移及局部溶剂电场的变化，进一步揭示了有限尺寸限制下出现的准相分离界面层是电场变化的来源。这些结果确立了基于nanoFTIR的VSE光谱作为纳米流体反应器中纳米溶剂电场的直接定量探测工具。

items.title: Environmental footprint of High-Throughput Screening technologies for enzyme discovery and engineering: a Life Cycle Assessment comparison
items.abstract: High-throughput screening (HTS) is widely used in enzyme discovery and engineering towards developing more sustainable industrial processes and environmental applications, yet it is a plastic intensive approach whose environmental performance has been rarely assessed quantitatively. Here, we conducted a comparative cradle-to-grave life cycle assessment (LCA) among four representative screening technologies to assay 1 million enzymes or enzyme variants: a pipettingbased liquid handling robot in 384-well plates (P-LHR 384 wp), an acoustic liquid handler in 1536-well plates (A-LHR 1536 wp), agar-based screening, and droplet microfluidics. Primary inventory data were compiled for reagents, plastics, and electricity consumption and translated into 16 Environmental Footprint (EF) impact categories. Droplet microfluidics consistently showed the lowest impacts nearly across the 16 EF indicators, typically by 1–3 orders of magnitude relative to conventional plate-based robotics. For climate change, droplet microfluidics reached 1.3 kg CO 2 eq per million assays, compared with 1381 kg CO 2 eq for P-LHR 384 wp, 150 kg CO 2 eq for A-LHR 1536 wp and 56 kg CO 2 eq for agar-based assays. The lower environmental impacts of droplet microfluidics emerged from extreme assay miniaturization and nearelimination of plastic disposables, shifting the impact contribution burden mainly to electricity use. A parallel cost analysis showed the same trend, from 850,000 € for P-LHR 384 wp to ~20 € for droplet microfluidics. These results identify reaction miniaturization, plastic reduction, and decarbonized electricity as the primary drivers for sustainable HTS enzyme discovery.
items.authors: Pablo Rodríguez-Mateos, Javier Sáez-Guinoa, Sara Lago-Olveira, Aurelio Hidalgo
items.title_zh: 高通量筛选技术的环境足迹：生命周期评估比较
items.summary_zh: 高通量筛选（HTS）广泛应用于酶的发现和工程，以开发更可持续的工业过程和环境应用，但其环境表现鲜有定量评估。本研究对四种代表性筛选技术进行了比较生命周期评估（LCA），以检测100万种酶或酶变体：384孔板的液体处理机器人（P-LHR 384 wp）、1536孔板的声学液体处理器（A-LHR 1536 wp）、琼脂基筛选和液滴微流体技术。我们编制了试剂、塑料和电力消耗的主要清单数据，并转化为16个环境足迹（EF）影响类别。液滴微流体技术在几乎所有16个EF指标中均表现出最低的环境影响，通常比传统的基于板的机器人低1-3个数量级。在气候变化方面，液滴微流体技术每百万次检测的二氧化碳当量为1.3 kg，而P-LHR 384 wp为1381 kg，A-LHR 1536 wp为150 kg，琼脂基检测为56 kg。液滴微流体技术的低环境影响源于极端的检测微型化和几乎消除塑料一次性用品，主要将影响负担转移至电力使用。

items.title: A benchmark dataset of 86 intermolecular interactions of neutrals, ions, radicals and radical ions with water and hydrogen sulfide
items.abstract: Guiding the selection of modern density functional approximations (DFAs) for intermolecular interactions requires diverse benchmark assessments. This work reports the development of a new test set of 86 binary complexes formed between either H 2 O or H 2 S and 31 selected partner species, comprising 15 neutral closed-shell molecules, 7 neutral radicals, 4 closed-shell anions, 2 closed-shell cations, and 3 cation radicals. The radical complexes are susceptible to delocalization error, while the interaction strengths span weak to very strong. Benchmark results are obtained at the coupled cluster singles, doubles and perturbative triples, CCSD(T), level, extrapolated towards the complete basis set limit from augmented triple and quadruple zeta basis calculations. This data is used to assess 17 different density functionals, spanning rungs 2 through 5 of Jacob’s Ladder. In common with other benchmarks, we find that the best functional on each higher rung of Jacob’s Ladder improves over the rung below, consistent with the potential to reduce the delocalization error. Only one functional, the ωB97M(2) double hybrid, achieves an RMS error of less than 1 kcal/mol. The best-performing hybrid is the recently introduced COACH functional, which has an RMS error just below 2 kcal/mol, while the best-performing meta-GGA and GGA have RMS errors above 3 and 4 kcal/mol respectively. These errors are dominated by the complexes that involve radical ions or neutral radicals. While the best-performing functionals are useful, these results indicate that further progress is still needed to address the delocalization error in intermolecular interactions.
items.authors: Rebecca Tomann, Partha P. Bera, Martin Head-Gordon
items.title_zh: 86种中性、离子、自由基及自由基离子与水和硫化氢的相互作用基准数据集
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一个新的测试集，包含86个二元复合物，这些复合物由水（H₂O）或硫化氢（H₂S）与31种选择的伙伴物种形成，包括15种中性闭壳层分子、7种中性自由基、4种闭壳层阴离子、2种闭壳层阳离子和3种阳离子自由基。自由基复合物易受去局域化误差影响，且相互作用强度从弱到非常强不等。基准结果在耦合簇单、双和微扰三重态（CCSD(T)）水平上获得，并通过增强的三重和四重ζ基组计算向完整基组极限外推。该数据用于评估17种不同的密度泛函，涵盖雅各布阶梯的第2至第5级。结果显示，每个更高阶梯的最佳泛函在降低去局域化误差方面优于下一级。只有ωB97M(2)双杂化泛函的均方根误差（RMS）低于1 kcal/mol，而新近引入的COACH泛函表现最佳，RMS误差略低于2 kcal/mol，最佳的meta-GGA和GGA泛函的RMS误差分别超过3和4 kcal/mol。

items.title: Redox-Metered Paired Electrolysis: A Strategy for Comprehensive Deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) Cross-Coupling
items.abstract: Interfacing transition metal catalysts with radical intermediates is a powerful paradigm for organic synthesis; however, it often requires the precise synchronization of independent catalytic cycles, and this requirement can limit scope and generality. We report a novel electrochemical strategy, which we term “redox-metered paired electrolysis,” in which the formation of a radical precursor in situ gates the rate of activation of its intended partner, thus promoting efficient cross-coupling across diverse substrate classes. We apply this strategy to the deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) cross-coupling of primary alkyl amines and aryl electrophiles, facilitated by the design of a bench-stable, dihydropyridine activating group. Notably, our redox-metered approach enables the cross-coupling of four categories of amines with five classes of aryl electrophiles—triflates, chlorides, bromides, iodides, and activated carboxylic acids—all under one unified set of conditions. Nineteen total pairs of amine and aryl electrophile classes are demonstrated to undergo catalytic cross-coupling ( 75 examples), including seven that have not been reported previously. These novel pairs include elusive, yet valuable bond formations, such as the deaminative cross-coupling of phenol-derived aryl triflates with amines and the coupling of aryl halides with α-amino acids. Time course analysis supports the proposed mechanism and reveals design principles for future applications of this strategy.
items.authors: Emma N. George, Mariah C. Castillo, Johnny Z. Wang, Chiyoung Ahn, Colin A. Gould
items.title_zh: 红氧计量配对电解：全面的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联策略
items.summary_zh: 将过渡金属催化剂与自由基中间体相结合是一种强有力的有机合成范式，但通常需要独立催化循环的精确同步，这限制了其适用范围和普遍性。我们提出了一种新颖的电化学策略，称为“红氧计量配对电解”，通过原位生成自由基前体来调控其目标反应物的活化速率，从而促进不同底物类别的高效交叉偶联。该策略应用于初级烷基胺与芳基电亲体的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联，设计了一个稳定的二氢吡啶活化基团。值得注意的是，我们的红氧计量方法使四类胺与五类芳基电亲体（包括三氟甲磺酸酯、氯、溴、碘及活化的羧酸）在统一条件下实现交叉偶联。共展示了十九对胺与芳基电亲体类别的催化交叉偶联（75个实例），其中七个为首次报道。这些新颖的配对包括一些难以获得但有价值的键合形成，如酚衍生芳基三氟甲磺酸酯与胺的去氨基交叉偶联及芳基卤化物与α-氨基酸的偶联。时间进程分析支持了这一提议。

items.title: ML26: New Ingredients for an Integral-Features Density Functional with Broad Chemical Accuracy
items.abstract: Integral-features density functional theory (IF-DFT) replaces the conventional integration over local ingredients with a nonlinear mapping from global integral descriptors, enabling machine-learned density functionals with broad transferability. Here we report ML26@MN15, a new IF functional that extends the earlier ML25@MN15 model by incorporating 12 additional correlation features—including overlap-projected rung-3.5 terms, CS1 dynamic-correlation ingredients, and VV10 nonlocal correlation—and by treating Hartree–Fock exchange as an integral feature rather than as a fixed hybrid percentage. ML26@MN15 employs 79 integral features evaluated on MN15 ingredients and a single-hidden-layer neural network with 5000 nodes to produce a size-extensive exchange–correlation energy. Trained on 185 databases comprising 7242 reference data, ML26@MN15 achieves a data-averaged energetic mean unsigned error of 0.89 kcal/mol, improving upon ML25@MN15 by 15% and outperforming a group of previous leading functionals across all eight chemical partitions examined. For the widely used MDB2019S, MGCDB84, and GMTKN55 datasets, ML26@MN15 yields the lowest averaged error among all tested functionals, including the results for GMTKN55 by ML-based Skala-1.1 and DM21 density functional approximations. The new functional also maintains strong performance for systems containing heavy elements and exhibits improved behavior on a challenging self-interaction benchmark. These results show that expanding the integral-feature space with physically motivated nonlocal ingredients yields a density functional with unprecedented accuracy across diverse chemical benchmarks. The broad and consistent accuracy of ML26@MN15 highlights the promise of integral-features density functional approximations as a scalable framework for incorporating additional nonlocal physics into future functional development.
items.authors: Dayou Zhang, Yinan Shu, Benjamin G. Janesko, Donald G. Truhlar
items.title_zh: ML26：具有广泛化学准确性的积分特征密度泛函新成分
items.summary_zh: 积分特征密度泛函理论（IF-DFT）通过从全局积分描述符进行非线性映射，取代了传统的局部成分积分，从而实现了具有广泛可转移性的机器学习密度泛函。本文报告了ML26@MN15，这是一种新型IF泛函，扩展了早期的ML25@MN15模型，增加了12个相关特征，包括重叠投影的3.5级项、CS1动态相关成分和VV10非局部相关，并将哈特里-福克交换视为积分特征而非固定混合百分比。ML26@MN15使用79个在MN15成分上评估的积分特征和一个具有5000个节点的单隐层神经网络，生成规模广泛的交换-相关能。经过185个数据库（共7242个参考数据）的训练，ML26@MN15实现了0.89 kcal/mol的数据平均能量无符号误差，比ML25@MN15提高了15%，并在所有八个化学分区中超越了多种领先的泛函。在广泛使用的MDB2019S、MGCDB84和GMTKN55数据集中，ML26@MN15在所有测试的泛函中表现出最低的平均误差，包括ML基的Skala-1.1和DM21密度泛函近似的GMTKN55结果。该新泛函在含重元素的系统中也保持了强劲的性能。

items.title: Reaction-orthogonal solid-state reference enables potentiometric studies of vapor phase thermochemical catalysis
items.abstract: Electrochemical mechanisms have been shown to be operative in the catalysis of numerous thermochemical redox reactions. These mechanisms have been elucidated by the measurement of the electrochemical potential of the catalyst during turnover (E cat ). A rich array of electrochemical tools allows for measurement of E cat during liquid-phase catalysis, but these are ill-suited to E cat measurements in higher temperature vapor-phase catalysis. Herein we report a solid electrolyte potentiometry (SEP) methodology that employs a Na β″-alumina solid electrolyte to measure E cat relative to the Na/Na + reference couple. As Na + is not typically a reactant or product in (electro)catalytic reactions, this reference is reaction-orthogonal, providing a common reference value for E cat measurement and analysis across diverse reaction classes and environments. Reaction-orthogonal SEP (RO-SEP) of Pt/C under H 2 enables measurement of the H 2 /H + equilibrium potential in the vapor phase across a wide temperature range from ambient to 325 °C. We find that promoting salts establish vapor phase proton activities comparable to their values in bulk aqueous medium, at ambient temperature. We apply RO-SEP to study the Au/C-catalyzed aerobic oxidation of 2-propanol to acetone and find that the catalyst is spontaneously and differentially polarized as a function of O 2 pressure under vapor phase reaction conditions. Simultaneous measurement of rate and E cat reveals a rate-potential scaling for vapor phase aerobic IPA oxidation that parallels that of liquid phase electrolytic IPA oxidation, suggesting a shared electrochemical mechanism between the two conditions. Lastly, H 2 /H + potentiometry reveals that alkali promoters in this reaction act principally via increasing the pH at the catalyst surface, which in turn enhances the kinetics of both the oxygen reduction and 2-propanol oxidation half-reaction. This reaction-orthogonal methodology for quantifying E cat enables broad-based investigations into the role of charge transfer in vapor phase heterogeneous catalysis.
items.authors: Deiaa M. Harraz, Cole S. Cadaram, Kunal M. Lodaya, Bryan Y. Tang, Yogesh Surendranath
items.title_zh: 反应正交固态参考实现气相热化学催化的电位测量
items.summary_zh: 电化学机制在多种热化学氧还原反应的催化中发挥作用。通过测量催化剂在反应过程中的电化学电位（E_cat），可以阐明这些机制。我们提出了一种固态电解质电位法（SEP），利用Na β″-铝土矿固态电解质相对于Na/Na+参考对E_cat进行测量。由于Na+通常不是电催化反应中的反应物或产物，该参考具有反应正交性，为不同反应类别和环境下的E_cat测量提供了共同的参考值。我们在H2气相下对Pt/C进行反应正交SEP（RO-SEP），在从常温到325°C的广泛温度范围内测量H2/H+平衡电位。结果表明，促进盐在气相中建立的质子活性与其在水相中的值相当。我们还应用RO-SEP研究了Au/C催化的2-丙醇的有氧氧化反应，发现催化剂在气相反应中随着O2压力的变化自发且差异性极化。

items.title: The Core Matters: Aggregation of Neutral Ligand-Coated Nanoparticles in Membranes
items.abstract: The aggregation of gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) influences their optical properties, including localized surface plasmon resonance, through plasmonic coupling between adjacent particles. For hydrophobic AuNPs embedded in lipid membranes, however, the mechanisms governing aggregation remain poorly understood. Although coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations are well suited to study these processes, commonly used ligand–nanoparticle (NP) models neglect explicit core interactions. Here, we test whether core properties regulate NP aggregation by simulating multiple Martini NP models in a membrane environment. In contrast to the assumption that surface ligands effectively shield the core, we find that interactions with the environment remain sensitive to core parameters even at maximum ligand coverage. Furthermore, core–solvent interactions are consistent with a mechanism that directly drives nanoparticle aggregation. These results suggest that core interactions can contribute to the aggregation of functionalized nanoparticles.
items.authors: Jahmal J. Ennis, Julianne C. Griepenburg, Grace Brannigan
items.title_zh: 核心影响：中性配体涂层纳米颗粒在膜中的聚集
items.summary_zh: 金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）的聚集影响其光学性质，包括局部表面等离子体共振，这通过相邻颗粒之间的等离子体耦合实现。然而，对于嵌入脂质膜中的疏水性AuNPs，控制聚集的机制仍不清楚。尽管粗粒度分子动力学模拟适合研究这些过程，但常用的配体-纳米颗粒模型忽略了核心的显式相互作用。本文通过在膜环境中模拟多种Martini纳米颗粒模型，测试核心特性是否调节纳米颗粒聚集。与假设表面配体有效屏蔽核心的观点相反，我们发现即使在最大配体覆盖下，环境与核心参数的相互作用仍然敏感。此外，核心-溶剂相互作用与直接驱动纳米颗粒聚集的机制一致。这些结果表明，核心相互作用可能对功能化纳米颗粒的聚集有所贡献。

items.title: Molecular Origins of Site-Specific CO2 Absorption in Hydrated Deep Eutectic Solvents
items.abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as promising candidates for CO 2 capture because of their highly tunable structures and CO 2 absorption capacities. However, their behavior under practical operating conditions remains poorly understood. In particular, the effect of water on DES structure and their CO 2 absorption capacity remains unclear. In this work, we use free energy perturbation (FEP) and molecular simulations to determine the CO 2 absorption capacities and transport properties of hydrated hydrophilic and hydrophobic DESs. Our results show that increasing water concentration decreases viscosity but also makes CO 2 solvation less favorable in both DESs, revealing a trade-off between transport properties and CO 2 absorption capacity. This trade-off is more favorable for the hydrophobic DES, which shows a substantial reduction in viscosity while maintaining a negative CO 2 solvation free energy. In contrast, the solvation free energy of the hydrophilic DES increases more substantially, becoming positive at 15 wt% H 2 O. Structural analysis reveals that these differences arise from distinct hydration and CO 2 solvation mechanisms in the two DESs. In the hydrophilic DES, CO 2 preferentially localizes around the Br – anion under dry conditions. Upon hydration, water blocks the anionic site, and the preferred CO 2 solvation site shifts to the cation.
items.authors: Deepak Kumar Panda, Soumik Das, Salman A. Khan
items.title_zh: 水合深共熔溶剂中CO2特定吸收的分子起源
items.summary_zh: 深共熔溶剂（DES）因其可调结构和CO2吸收能力而成为捕集CO2的有前景候选者。然而，其在实际操作条件下的行为仍不清楚，尤其是水对DES结构和CO2吸收能力的影响。本研究采用自由能扰动（FEP）和分子模拟方法，确定了水合亲水性和疏水性DES的CO2吸收能力和传输特性。结果表明，增加水浓度降低了粘度，但也使得两种DES中的CO2溶剂化变得不利，显示出传输特性与CO2吸收能力之间的权衡。疏水性DES在保持负的CO2溶剂化自由能的同时，粘度显著降低，而亲水性DES的溶剂化自由能则显著增加，在15 wt% H2O时变为正值。结构分析表明，这些差异源于两种DES中不同的水合和CO2溶剂化机制。

items.title: Hyperlocal Sensing and Inverse Modeling Reveal Community Impacts of Urban Air Pollutant Emissions
items.abstract: Addressing urban air pollution requires identifying, quantifying, and mitigating emission sources, yet bottom-up inventories often lack fine spatiotemporal precision and rarely capture unpermitted or informally operated sources. We combine dense mobile and fixed-site measurements in a Bayesian inverse modeling framework to produce hourly, hyperlocal black carbon (BC) emission maps (150 m × 150 m) that reveal how and where key sources are underrepresented. In West Oakland, CA — an overburdened community near major freight infrastructure — our approach identifies underestimated and unaccounted emission sources, increasing estimated BC emissions by ~33%. These corrections quadruple the contribution of neighborhood and port-related sources to population-weighted exposures (from 5 to 20%), disproportionately affecting low-income neighborhoods adjacent to freight corridors. Our results demonstrate that combining dense observational data with inverse modeling enables detection and quantification of overlooked emissions, supporting targeted intervention. Sensitivity analyses indicate similar performance with a substantially reduced fixed-site network (~10 monitors; ~1 site / km 2 , compared with 6.7 sites/km 2 in the full campaign), paired with time-averaged mobile maps, supporting applicability in data-limited urban settings.
items.authors: Chirag Manchanda, Ronald Cohen, Ramon Alvarez, Tammy Thompson, Maria Harris, Alexander Turner
items.title_zh: 超本地传感与反演建模揭示城市空气污染排放的社区影响
items.summary_zh: 应对城市空气污染需要识别、量化和减轻排放源，但自下而上的清单往往缺乏精细的时空精度，且很少捕捉到未获许可或非正式运营的源。我们结合密集的移动和固定站点测量，在贝叶斯反演建模框架下，生成每小时超本地黑碳（BC）排放地图（150 m × 150 m），揭示关键源的低估情况。在加利福尼亚州西奥克兰——一个靠近主要货运基础设施的负担过重社区——我们的方法识别出低估和未考虑的排放源，使估计的BC排放量增加约33%。这些修正使邻里和港口相关源对加权人口暴露的贡献增加四倍（从5%增至20%），对靠近货运走廊的低收入社区影响尤为显著。我们的结果表明，结合密集观测数据与反演建模能够检测和量化被忽视的排放，支持有针对性的干预。敏感性分析表明，使用大幅减少的固定站点网络（约10个监测器；约1个站点/km²，与完整调查中的6.7个站点/km²相比）与时间平均的移动地图结合，表现相似，支持在数据有限的城市环境中的适用性。

items.title: Transport-guided intensification of plasma activation spray for scalable and tunable water treatment
items.abstract: Interaction of cold plasma with aqueous media underpins emerging technologies in water treatment, chemical conversion, and biomedicine, yet scalable plasma-liquid activation remains limited by inefficient gas-liquid mass transfer and rapid reactive-species decay. This study reports a droplet-based plasma activation spray (PAS) reactor and establishes transport-guided design principles for intensifying reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) capture. Through systematic variation in spray-nozzle size, chamber geometry, and gas flow, we identify regimes governing the magnitude and composition of plasma activation. Smaller droplets (∼342 µm) favored reactive nitrogen species uptake through increased interfacial area, whereas larger droplets (∼1.3 mm) accumulated hydrogen peroxide through bulk-phase retention. Larger chambers extended droplet flight time and enhanced bulk accumulation, while positioning electrodes near the liquid interface minimized short-lived species transport losses. Spatial repositioning of multiple needles further improved the plasma activation by covering inactive zones. These design principles, validated in scaled PAS systems, achieved peak energy yields ( 1.84 mmol/MJ at liter-scale) and enabled rapid antibiotic degradation and superior ≥ 5-log microbial inactivation, bridging the gap between plasma science and large-scale environmental application. The results position PAS as a tunable and scalable platform, providing a robust engineering framework that couples plasma physics with droplet hydrodynamics for high-throughput water activation.
items.authors: Hon Man Luk, Deepak Panchal, Qiuyun Lu, Siyu Chen, Xuehua Zhang
items.title_zh: 基于传输引导的等离子体激活喷雾强化水处理
items.summary_zh: 冷等离子体与水相的相互作用是水处理、化学转化和生物医学等新兴技术的基础，但可扩展的等离子体-液体激活受到气-液传质效率低和反应物种快速衰减的限制。本研究报告了一种基于液滴的等离子体激活喷雾（PAS）反应器，并建立了传输引导的设计原则以增强反应性氧和氮物种（RONS）的捕获。通过系统变化喷嘴尺寸、腔体几何形状和气体流动，我们识别了影响等离子体激活强度和成分的机制。较小的液滴（∼342 µm）通过增加界面面积促进了反应性氮物种的吸收，而较大的液滴（∼1.3 mm）则通过体相保留积累了过氧化氢。较大的腔体延长了液滴飞行时间并增强了体相积累，同时将电极靠近液体界面可最小化短寿命物种的传输损失。多个针头的空间重新定位进一步改善了等离子体激活，覆盖了非活跃区域。这些在扩展的PAS系统中验证的设计原则实现了峰值能量产率（1.84 mmol/MJ，升级规模），并促进了快速抗生素降解和≥5-log微生物灭活，缩小了等离子体科学与大规模环境应用之间的差距。

items.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
items.abstract: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the individual GNNs or ChemBERTa-only models. Random splitting on the RF model exhibits a better R2 score than on a scaffold-split dataset. Because under scaffold splitting the model predicts on unseen cores, the task becomes more difficult than under regular random splitting.
items.authors: Pradyumna Kumar Pradhan
items.title_zh: 基于支架分割的血浆蛋白结合预测：树模型、ChemBERTa与图网络
items.summary_zh: 药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程，科学家通过机器学习和人工智能优先选择更有可能成功的分子。本研究使用DeepChem的MoleculeNet中的血浆蛋白结合（PPB）数据集，结合多种图神经网络（GNN）、ChemBERTa（用于分子SMILES字符串的语言模型）及其融合模型。与标准树模型随机森林（RF）和XGBoost进行比较，采用支架分割方法评估模型性能。结果表明，GNN和ChemBERTa模型在PPB数据集上的表现优于树模型，融合模型的平均表现优于单一的GNN或ChemBERTa模型。随机分割的RF模型在R2评分上优于支架分割数据集，因为在支架分割下模型对未见核心进行预测。

items.title: Performance of Highly Coarse-Grained Chain Models with Extremal Measures for a Configuration-Dependent Hydrodynamic Diameter in Rheological Flow Fields
items.abstract: In the presence of fluctuating hydrodynamic interactions (HI), coarse-grained beadspring models are known to show large deviations in rheological predictions relative to finely resolved chain models. In a recent study, we formulated a modified bead-spring approach where the bead hydrodynamic diameter increases proportionally to the mean spring stretch. Significant improvements were observed in the resulting predictions for rheological flow fields for models with many springs. In the new approach, a balanced accuracy across flow types was obtained with the harmonic mean strategy to obtain the mean stretch. In this study, we explore the limits of this approach with highly coarse-grained models consisting of very few springs. Additionally, we test the behavior of two extremal measures to set the bead hydrodynamic diameter. Note, due to the computational complexity with HI, minimizing the number of beads is highly preferable for any application. Surprisingly, our results show the validity of the approach for high degrees of coarse-graining up to only 3 springs, even with the extremal measures, particularly for extensional flows. Predictions in shear flows become better with increasing number of springs, with a good agreement observed with 10 springs.
items.authors: Lokesh Yadav, Praphul Kumar, S. V. Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal
items.title_zh: 极限测量下粗粒链模型在流变场中的表现
items.summary_zh: 在波动的流体动力学相互作用下，粗粒化的珠-弹簧模型相较于精细解析的链模型在流变预测上存在较大偏差。我们提出了一种改进的珠-弹簧方法，使得珠的流体动力学直径与平均弹簧伸长成正比。对于具有多个弹簧的模型，流变流场的预测显著改善。新方法通过调和平均策略获得平均伸长，实现了不同流动类型的平衡准确性。本研究探讨了该方法在极少弹簧的高度粗粒化模型中的局限性，并测试了两种极限测量设置珠的流体动力学直径。结果表明，该方法在高粗粒化程度下仍有效，最多可支持3个弹簧，尤其在拉伸流中表现良好。随着弹簧数量的增加，剪切流的预测精度也有所提高，10个弹簧时的结果与理论相符。

items.title: Cationic Selenuranes Enable Direct Linchpin Formation in Arenes
items.abstract: The formation of linchpins is a powerful strategy for increasing molecular complexity. Chalcogenonium salts have become valuable intermediates for molecular diversification, owing to their exceptional chemoselectivity in arene C–H functionalization and a synthetic versatility comparable to that of halides and pseudohalides. Sulfonium group introduction through an isohypsic process from S(IV) precursors requires activation with strong acids or anhydrides. Here, we report the direct synthesis of selenonium salts from bench-stable Se(III) cationic selenuranes using a simple dump-and-stir protocol. The transformation proceeds under air at ambient temperature and requires no exogenous activators. Mechanistic investigations reveal high sensitivity to electronic effects (ρ = −10), whereas site selectivity is determined by the rate-limiting deprotonation step (kH/kD = 2.3). The method is scalable to 10.0 mmol ( 6.2 g) and provides direct access to selenonium salts derived from complex molecules. The resulting selenonium salts serve as versatile linchpins for photochemical, nucleophilic, and transition-metal-catalyzed transformations, enabling late-stage molecular diversification.
items.authors: Kirill Zhiliaev, Till Schreyer, Mihai V. Popescu, Javier Mateos
items.title_zh: 阳离子硒氨盐实现芳烃中直接连接体的形成
items.summary_zh: 连接体的形成是一种有效的增加分子复杂性的策略。由于其在芳烃C–H功能化中的优异化学选择性，硫族阳离子盐已成为分子多样化的重要中间体。通过S(IV)前体的等高过程引入磺基团需要强酸或酸酐的激活。本文报道了一种从稳定的Se(III)阳离子硒氨盐直接合成硒氨盐的方法，采用简单的倾倒搅拌协议。该转化在常温下的空气中进行，无需外源激活剂。机理研究显示对电子效应高度敏感（ρ = −10），而位点选择性由速率限制的去质子化步骤决定（kH/kD = 2.3）。该方法可扩展至10.0 mmol（6.2 g），并直接获得源自复杂分子的硒氨盐。所得硒氨盐可作为多功能连接体，支持光化学、亲核和过渡金属催化转化，实现后期分子多样化。

items.title: Microphase Separation and Water Accessibility in Crosslinked Polyurethanes
items.abstract: Polyurethane materials are among the most widely used synthetic polymers, yet the atomic-scale structural organisation governing their macroscopic properties remains largely elusive. Despite decades of study, the chain organisation of hard and soft domains in polyurethane remains poorly understood because experimental techniques cannot resolve chain packing and intermolecular interactions at atomistic resolution. Here we combine Monte Carlo-based downsampling of chain length distributions fitted to experimental data with an iterative crosslinking protocol coupled to molecular dynamics relaxation to generate fully atomistic models of heterogeneous polymers with varying crosslinking degrees, using toluene diisocyanate (TDI) and propoxylated glycerol-based polyurethane as a model system. The resulting models reproduce available experimental thermodynamic and structural data, and spontaneously develop microphase separated morphologies consistent with experimental observations. The simulations reveal that hard segment aggregation is a major organisational factor driving microphase separation. Within hard domains, interchain NH· · ·O=C hydrogen bonds dominate cohesive interactions, while atomistic resolution reveals aromatic packing motifs consistent with π-π interactions between aromatic rings in both parallel and perpendicular geometries. At the polyurethane-water interface, urea and amine groups are the most solvent-exposed and retain well-defined hydration shells, whereas urethane linkages remain comparatively shielded. Together, these results provide an atomistic account of hard domain formation and microphase separation in polyurethane, and establish how this morphology governs the accessibility of urethane bonds to catalytic cleavage. The approach provides a framework for investigating structure-property relationships in heterogeneous amorphous polymer systems, with potential applications ranging from enzymatic degradation to materials design.
items.authors: Alexandre V. Pinto, Pedro A. Fernandes, Maria J. Ramos
items.title_zh: 交联聚氨酯的微相分离与水的可及性
items.summary_zh: 聚氨酯材料是应用最广泛的合成聚合物之一，但其原子级结构组织对宏观性质的影响仍不清楚。尽管经过数十年的研究，聚氨酯中硬段和软段的链组织仍然不够理解，因为实验技术无法以原子分辨率解析链的堆积和分子间相互作用。本文结合基于蒙特卡罗的链长分布下采样与分子动力学松弛的迭代交联协议，生成具有不同交联度的异质聚合物的全原子模型，以甲苯二异氰酸酯（TDI）和丙氧基化甘油基聚氨酯为模型系统。结果模型再现了现有的热力学和结构数据，并自发形成与实验观察一致的微相分离形态。模拟结果表明，硬段聚集是驱动微相分离的主要组织因素。硬段内，链间的NH· · ·O=C氢键主导了内聚相互作用，而原子分辨率揭示了与芳香环之间的π-π相互作用一致的芳香堆积模式。

items.title: Accumulation of enzymes on the lipid-oleosin membarnes
items.abstract: Engineering the spatial organization of proteins offers a powerful strategy for controlling biochemical reactions and material properties in synthetic cells. However, dynamically organizing multiple proteins at the nanometer scale remains challenging. We developed asymmetric lipid–oleosin hybrid vesicles in which engineered oleosin molecules served as membrane-forming scaffolds with two orthogonal conjugation systems. External chemical stimuli rapidly recruited two distinct proteins to individual oleosin molecules, generating persistent nanometer-scale proximity, as demonstrated by single-molecule tracking. In an alditol oxidase–horseradish peroxidase cascade, organization of both enzymes on the same oleosin scaffold enhanced product formation compared with intermolecular membrane recruitment. This localized cascade further drove stimulus-responsive polymerization to form membrane-associated cytoskeleton-like structures, increasing vesicle resistance to hypertonic stress. This programmable membrane scaffold couples external signals with molecular organization, enhanced biochemical reactions, and membrane mechanics, providing a framework for engineering synthetic cells that convert chemical inputs into programmable reactions and material outputs.
items.authors: Masato Suzuki, Rinshi S. Kasai, Koki Kamiya
items.title_zh: 脂质-油蛋白膜上酶的积累研究
items.summary_zh: 工程化蛋白质的空间组织为控制合成细胞中的生化反应和材料特性提供了有效策略。然而，在纳米尺度上动态组织多种蛋白质仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了不对称的脂质-油蛋白混合囊泡，其中工程化的油蛋白分子作为膜形成支架，具有两种正交的结合系统。外部化学刺激快速招募两种不同的蛋白质到各自的油蛋白分子上，产生持久的纳米级接近性。通过单分子追踪证明，在醇糖氧化酶-辣根过氧化物酶级联反应中，两个酶在同一油蛋白支架上的组织相比于分子间膜招募增强了产物形成。该局部级联反应进一步驱动刺激响应聚合，形成膜相关的细胞骨架样结构，提高了囊泡对高渗透压的抵抗力。该可编程膜支架将外部信号与分子组织、生化反应和膜力学相结合，为工程化合成细胞提供了将化学输入转化为可编程反应和材料输出的框架。

items.title: Finite-Field Second Hyperpolarizability via Adaptive Bayesian Quantum Phase Estimation for Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers: Ground-State Energies Beyond Chemical Accuracy
items.abstract: The static second hyperpolarizability governs third-order nonlinear-optical responses but is difficult to compute by first-principles methods because finite-field extraction requires a fourth-order energy derivative. The resulting error amplification demands sub-µHa ground-state energies, far beyond conventional chemical accuracy. Standard multi-qubit QPE can in principle meet this precision but requires a wide ancilla register, while single-ancilla iterative QPE (IQPE) is limited by a binary-grid quantization floor. We develop an adaptive Bayesian QPE (BQPE) workflow that uses a single ancilla, terminal measurements, and real-time classical feedback to estimate the eigenphase through a continuous posterior rather than a fixed binary grid. For a linear H4 chain in the STO-3G basis, represented by a six-qubit parity Hamiltonian with one ancilla, BQPE reaches a ground-state energy error of ≈ 10−7 Ha at controlled-U depth mmax ≈ 215, about two orders of magnitude below the IQPE floor. Propagated through the finite-field stencil and Richardson extrapolation, these energies recover the second hyperpolarizability within ±10% of the FCI reference over the stable field-strength plateau, whereas IQPE at the same depth fails to do so. These results indicate that grid-free Bayesian phase estimation can make nonlinear-optical properties accessible on early fault-tolerant quantum computers.
items.authors: Katsuki Okuno
items.title_zh: 自适应贝叶斯量子相位估计的有限场二次超极化率研究
items.summary_zh: 静态二次超极化率决定了三阶非线性光学响应，但由于有限场提取需要四阶能量导数，故难以通过第一性原理计算。所需的亚µHa基态能量远超常规化学精度。标准多量子比特量子相位估计（QPE）理论上可达到该精度，但需要较大的辅助寄存器，而单辅助迭代QPE（IQPE）受限于二进制网格量化。我们开发了一种自适应贝叶斯QPE（BQPE）工作流程，利用单个辅助量子比特、终端测量和实时经典反馈，通过连续后验估计特征相位。对于STO-3G基中的线性H4链，BQPE在受控-U深度mmax ≈ 215时达到约10−7 Ha的基态能量误差，约比IQPE低两个数量级。通过有限场模板和理查森外推，这些能量在稳定场强区间内恢复了二次超极化率，误差在±10%内，而同深度的IQPE未能实现。这些结果表明，无网格贝叶斯相位估计能够使早期容错量子计算机上的非线性光学特性可及。

items.title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
items.abstract: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms.
items.authors: Shaozhen Ding, Peng Wu, Shubo Li, Yuxuan Yang, Han Zhu, Heng Yu
items.title_zh: 数据驱动的酶工程策略：从机器学习到蛋白质语言模型
items.summary_zh: 酶是推动多种生物过程和工业应用的关键生物催化剂，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，庞大的酶序列空间和有限的功能注释使得加速酶发现和工程的计算方法需求迫切。近期计算方法的进展正在将酶工程从经验试错转向预测设计。本文总结了酶工程工作流程中的代表性计算工具和预测模型，包括（1）酶数据资源，（2）功能酶发现，（3）酶性质预测（如动力学、最佳温度和pH、溶解度、广谱性和特异性），（4）de novo酶设计，以及（5）计算指导的酶优化。我们进一步比较了当前的计算策略，讨论其在不同工程场景中的优缺点，并强调了基础模型、生成性人工智能、多模态学习和闭环设计-构建-测试-学习平台的 emerging trends。

items.title: Contrastive Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Goal Directed 3D Molecular Design
items.abstract: Although three-dimensional flow-matching models have become powerful tools for efficient sampling of high-quality 3D molecular structures, reward-based reinforcement learning for flow-matching models is complicated by the absence of a tractable trajectory likelihood for hybrid molecular states comprising categorical features and continuous coordinates. Existing policy-optimization strategies address this difficulty by stochasticizing the generative process or constructing likelihood surrogates, introducing additional approximations. Here, we present ReCoFlow, a novel trajectorylikelihood-free reinforcement learning framework for reward-contrastive post-training of pretrained molecular flow-matching models. Within ReCoFlow, reward-favored molecules provide positive endpoint supervision for the flow-matching model, whereas reward-disfavored molecules are used to construct reference-guided negative targets. Additionally, an anchor loss to an exponential moving average (EMA) reference model constrains the drift of the fine-tuned model. In benchmarking studies including physicochemical property optimization, three-dimensional shape optimization, and pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation, ReCoFlow consistently improved the performance of flow-matching models over reward-weighted and surrogate-ratio optimization schemes while maintaining high molecular validity. These results suggest that ReCoFlow could be an effective reinforcement-learning strategy for goal-directed molecular design.
items.authors: Bohao Li, Yuedong Yang, Mingyuan Xu, Hongming Chen
items.title_zh: 基于对比奖励的目标导向3D分子设计强化学习
items.summary_zh: 三维流匹配模型已成为高效采样高质量3D分子结构的强大工具，但基于奖励的强化学习因缺乏可处理的轨迹似然性而复杂化。现有的策略优化方法通过随机化生成过程或构建似然替代品来解决这一问题，带来了额外的近似。本文提出了ReCoFlow，一种新颖的无轨迹似然性强化学习框架，用于对预训练的分子流匹配模型进行奖励对比后训练。在ReCoFlow中，奖励偏好的分子为流匹配模型提供正向监督，而奖励不偏好的分子用于构建参考引导的负目标。此外，锚损失与指数移动平均（EMA）参考模型的结合限制了微调模型的漂移。在包括物理化学性质优化、三维形状优化和口袋条件3D分子生成的基准研究中，ReCoFlow在保持高分子有效性的同时，持续提升了流匹配模型的性能，优于奖励加权和替代比优化方案。

items.title: Conformal Prediction and Multi-Ensemble Gradient Boosting for Subtype-Selective Binding Affinity Estimation Across Human Adenosine Receptors
items.abstract: Subtype selectivity across human adenosine GPCRs remains an intractable medicinal chemistry challenge. The four orthosteric binding pockets share over 70% sequence homology across transmembrane helices III, V, VI, and VII. Consequently, standard QSAR models fail prospectively. They suffer from systemic scaffold leakage, overestimating held-out affinity while producing point estimates that lack calibrated error bars. We built an open-source, leak-free computational platform to solve both failure modes. The architecture combines XGBoost gradient boosting with MAPIE Jackknife+ cross-conformal prediction, Random Forest, and LightGBM, trained on 9,589 curated ChEMBL v34 and GPCRdb bioactivity records. Under strict Bemis-Murcko scaffold partitioning (N_train = 6,332; N_test = 1,583), the ensemble achieved an overall R2 of 0.693 and MAE of 0.390 pChEMBL units. On active compounds alone (N_test = 3,771, structural decoys removed), accuracy reached an overall R2 of 0.865 and MAE of 0.314. Per-subtype R2 values reached 0.753 for A1, 0.884 for A2A, 0.912 for A2B, and 0.886 for A3. Conformal intervals delivered 85.80% empirical coverage at a 90% nominal confidence level. Uncertainty quartiles scaled monotonically with absolute prediction error. A GINE graph neural network trained on identical scaffold splits managed only R2 = 0.248 overall, demonstrating that curated physicochemical descriptors decisively outperform deep graph convolutions in low-to-medium data regimes. Twenty-fold Y-randomization confirmed genuine structure-activity relationships, with all permuted R2 values falling below zero (p 0.001). External blind validation on 15 novel GPCRdb ligands yielded a 75% selectivity recall accuracy. TreeSHAP features attributions verified that model decisions follow interpretable electrostatic and steric properties. All source code, curated data splits, model weights, and interactive deployment are publicly available.
items.authors: Utkarsh Patel
items.title_zh: 用于人腺苷受体亚型选择性结合亲和力估计的共形预测与多集成梯度提升方法
items.summary_zh: 人腺苷GPCRs的亚型选择性仍然是药物化学中的一大挑战。四个正位结合口袋在跨膜螺旋III、V、VI和VII中共享超过70%的序列同源性，因此标准的QSAR模型在前瞻性预测中失效，存在系统性框架泄漏，导致对保留亲和力的高估，并且产生的点估计缺乏校准的误差条。我们构建了一个开源、无泄漏的计算平台，结合了XGBoost梯度提升、MAPIE Jackknife+交叉共形预测、随机森林和LightGBM，基于9,589条经过整理的ChEMBL v34和GPCRdb生物活性记录进行训练。在严格的Bemis-Murcko框架分割下（N_train = 6,332; N_test = 1,583），该集成模型整体R²为0.693，MAE为0.390 pChEMBL单位。仅在活性化合物上（N_test = 3,771，去除结构伪像），准确度达到整体R²为0.865，MAE为0.314。各亚型R²值分别为A1的0.753，A2A的0.884，A2B的0.912，以及A3的0.886。共形区间在90%的名义置信水平下提供了85.80%的经验覆盖率。预测误差的绝对值与不确定性四分位数单调增加。经过相同框架分割训练的GINE图神经网络整体仅达到R² = 0.248，显示出整理的物理化学描述符的局限性。

items.title: Evolution of primary loops in vitrimers
items.abstract: Covalent adaptable networks (CANs) comprise dynamic covalent bonds that allow topological reconfiguration. While this behavior underlies the reprocessability and recyclability of CANs, its influence on network topology, including defects, remains poorly understood. Prior simulations and indirect experimental studies suggest that dynamic exchange decreases the prevalence of primary loops, but direct experimental quantification has remained elusive. Here we use network disassembly spectrometry (NDS) to directly measure topological evolution during dynamic exchange. Surprisingly, activation of exchange at constant composition reveals two distinct concentration-dependent regimes. At concentrations above ~0.2 M, primary loops decrease upon activating exchange, whereas at lower concentrations, loop content increases, leading to gel-sol transitions. Temperature-dependent experiments and coarse-grained simulations suggest that these trends arise from competing entropic contributions that favor either loop formation or consumption depending on concentration. Changes in topology are accompanied by measurable changes in mechanical properties, demonstrating a direct relationship between network structure and macroscopic behavior. Furthermore, the concentration-dependent transition enables topology-mediated recycling, in which materials reversibly transition between gel and sol states through network rearrangement alone. These results provide the first direct experimental evidence of topology evolution in covalent adaptable networks and establish network topology as a measurable and tunable design parameter in dynamic polymer systems.
items.authors: Emmanuel A. Garcia Villatoro, Sullivan W. Fitz, Jolly Patro, Alexis Martell Monterroza, Jeremiah A. Johnson, Olvera de la Cruz
items.title_zh: 维特聚合物中初级环的演变研究
items.summary_zh: 共价可调网络（CANs）由动态共价键组成，允许拓扑重构。尽管这一特性是CANs可再加工和可回收的基础，但其对网络拓扑（包括缺陷）的影响仍不甚了解。以往的模拟和间接实验研究表明，动态交换会减少初级环的出现，但直接的实验定量仍然缺乏。本文采用网络解体光谱法（NDS）直接测量动态交换过程中的拓扑演变。结果显示，在恒定组成下激活交换时，出现了两个不同的浓度依赖性区域。在浓度高于约0.2 M时，激活交换会减少初级环的数量，而在较低浓度下，环的含量增加，导致凝胶-溶液转变。温度依赖性实验和粗粒度模拟表明，这些趋势源于竞争的熵贡献，取决于浓度，影响环的形成或消耗。拓扑变化伴随着可测量的机械性能变化，表明网络结构与宏观行为之间存在直接关系。此外，浓度依赖性转变使得拓扑介导的回收成为可能，材料在凝胶和溶液状态之间可逆转变。

items.title: Olympic-patterned pentaboron emitter featuring highly distorted geometry enables efficient solution-processed ultrapure green OLEDs
items.abstract: Efficient, ultrapure green organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) fabricated via wet processing are crucial for ultrahigh definition displays but remain highly challenging due to the paucity of suitable emitters. Herein, we developed Oly-BN, a novel multipleresonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence (MR-TADF) emitter featuring a distinct Olympic-patterned boron-distribution. The zigzag doped heteroatom polycyclic aromatic framework enables near-degenerate singlet/triplet excited states. Integrating para-N-π-B motifs helps regulate the triplet manifold and emission color point, enabling energetically accessible higher lying triplet excited states with enhanced spinorbit coupling, while also suppressing low-frequency structural relaxation and modulating the optical bandgap. Oly-BN in toluene exhibits vivid green emission at 522 nm with a narrow full width at half maximum (FWHM) of 17 nm, a photoluminescence quantum yield of 95%, and a fast reverse intersystem crossing rate constant of 6.9×106 s−1. Additionally, its highly twisted conformation weakens intermolecular interactions and favors bright, solid-state emission. The nonsensitized solution-processed OLEDs deliver ultrapure green electroluminescence with a CIEy value up to 0.73, and achieves an optimized maximum external quantum efficiency of 39.4%, which remains high at 29.9% at 1000 cd m-2. This work not only provides a promising highly saturated green emitter for solution-processed OLEDs but also demonstrates the importance of precisely integrating heteroatoms in modulating photophysical properties of MR-TADF emitters.
items.authors: Xin Xiong, Rajat Walia, Dongyang Chen, Cheng-Xi Li, Xiao-Chun Fan, Xian-Kai Chen
items.title_zh: 具有奥林匹克图案的五硼发射体实现高效超纯绿色OLED
items.summary_zh: 高效的超纯绿色有机发光二极管（OLED）对于超高清显示至关重要，但由于适合的发射体稀缺，仍然面临挑战。本研究开发了Oly-BN，一种新型多重共振热激活延迟荧光（MR-TADF）发射体，具有独特的奥林匹克图案硼分布。锯齿形掺杂异原子多环芳香框架使单重态/三重态激发态接近简并。整合对-N-π-B基元有助于调节三重态能级和发射色点，促进能量可及的高能三重态激发态，增强自旋-轨道耦合，同时抑制低频结构弛豫并调节光学带隙。Oly-BN在甲苯中表现出522 nm的鲜艳绿色发射，半高宽（FWHM）为17 nm，光致发光量子产率为95%，快速反向系综交叉速率常数为6.9×10^6 s−1。此外，其高度扭曲的构象减弱了分子间相互作用，促进了明亮的固态发射。非敏化的溶液处理OLED实现了超纯绿色电致发光，CIEy值高达0.73，优化的最大外量子效率为39.4%，在1000 cd m-2时仍保持29.9%的高值。

items.title: Catalytic Phosphorus-Based Hydrogen Atom
items.abstract: We report the first catalytic phosphorus-based hydrogen atom transfer system. Using an iridium photocatalyst and 10 mol% diphenylphosphine sulfide, we achieve decarboxylative reduction of diverse carboxylic acids—including peptides and pharmaceuticals—to C–H products in up to 95% yield, without stoichiometric reductants. Mechanistic studies reveal an unprecedented anionic relay: a phosphoryl radical is reduced to a phosphinoyl anion, which upon protonation regenerates the P–H catalyst. This work establishes catalytic turnover in phosphorus-based HAT and identifies a new elementary step in main-group radical chemistry.
items.authors: Pratik Avinash, Kayla Merrigan, Bartosz Bieszczad
items.title_zh: 催化磷基氢原子转移系统的研究
items.summary_zh: 我们报道了首个催化磷基氢原子转移系统。通过使用铱光催化剂和10 mol%的二苯基磷硫化物，我们实现了多种羧酸（包括肽类和药物）的脱羧还原，C–H产物的产率高达95%，且无需化学计量还原剂。机理研究揭示了一种前所未有的阴离子中继过程：磷酰自由基被还原为磷酰阴离子，后者在质子化后再生P–H催化剂。这项工作确立了磷基氢原子转移的催化循环，并识别了主族自由基化学中的一个新基本步骤。

items.title: Vicem: Automating Molecular Mechanics Modeling of Solvation Dynamics with Applications to Time-Resolved X-ray Scattering
items.abstract: Time-resolved X-ray solution scattering (trXSS) probes molecular-scale structural dynamics in solution, but its interpretation requires efficient computational methodologies and models for assessing how changes in solute structure and charge distribution affect the surrounding solvent shell and the resulting scattering signal. We present VICEM, an OpenMM/ASE-based software suite for constructing solvated molecular models, running molecular dynamics simulations, inspecting and analyzing the resulting trajectories, while exposing solute geometry, partial charges, Lennard–Jones parameters, and bonded terms as editable variables for model refinement. VICEM includes an approximate restrained-solute model designed for rapid solvent-shell sampling around prescribed solute geometries, together with utilities for correcting the potential energy along selected intramolecular coordinates. We benchmark the restrained model against established force fields for 244 systems comprising neutral organic molecules, charged organic solutes, and transition-metal complexes. Across 5018 solute-water radial distribution functions, the effect of restraining the solute structure on the solvent shell is generally comparable to differences between established flexible force fields, and diagnostic cases are scrutinized to identify when reference geometry, nonbonded assignment, or suppressed solute flexibility controls the solvent response. For a prototypical iron complex, VICEM is used to scan candidate geometries and quantify the effect of the structure on solvent-shell radial distribution functions and the corresponding scattering signal, showing how VICEM can be used to tune molecular models for structural refinement. VICEM is therefore shown to provide a platform for reproducible solvent-shell modeling and targeted force-field refinement with particular focus on trXSS analysis.
items.authors: A. O. Dohn, D. Llorena Prieto, E. Selenius, M. Haubro, K. Haldrup, K. B. Møller
items.title_zh: Vicem：自动化分子力学建模溶剂动力学的应用研究
items.summary_zh: 时间分辨X射线溶液散射（trXSS）探测溶液中分子尺度的结构动态，但其解释需要高效的计算方法和模型，以评估溶质结构和电荷分布的变化如何影响周围的溶剂壳及其散射信号。我们提出了VICEM，一个基于OpenMM/ASE的软件套件，用于构建溶剂化分子模型、运行分子动力学模拟、检查和分析结果轨迹，同时将溶质几何、部分电荷、Lennard-Jones参数和键合项作为可编辑变量以便模型优化。VICEM包含一个近似的约束溶质模型，旨在快速采样指定溶质几何周围的溶剂壳，并提供纠正选定分子内坐标的势能的工具。我们对244个系统的约束模型进行了基准测试，结果表明约束溶质结构对溶剂壳的影响通常与已建立的柔性力场之间的差异相当。

items.title: The Gated Quantum Resonator: a reduced-representation Hamiltonian–network framework for gated driven–dissipative quantum systems
items.abstract: High-dimensional driven–dissipative systems are often described either microscopically or through reduced models whose relation to the underlying dynamics is unclear. Originally motivated by geometrygated catalytic and enzymatic dynamics, the construction is developed here independently of any particular molecular application. We formulate the Gated Quantum Resonator (GQR) as a controlled reducedrepresentation framework in which selected coherent coordinates are modulated by structural or environmental gates. The retained coordinates are supplied by an upstream modelling step; no projection or truncation algorithm is introduced. From a gate-dependent Hamiltonian we develop complementary mode, network and port–Hamiltonian representations, distinguishing exact preservation properties from phenomenological closures requiring independent validation. Open-system dynamics are introduced through a GKSL generator. For the linear lossless sector, the specified mechanical–network map exactly preserves normal-mode frequencies and modal eigenspaces, while matched input–output equality is a consistency property by construction. An exactly solvable lossy three-state bridge then shows that a previously proposed coupling–loss–dephasing coordinate does not select a universal microscopic transport optimum. The framework therefore treats reduced models as generators of explicit mechanistic hypotheses whose spectral, transport and geometric consequences can be tested, narrowed or rejected by independent physical evidence.
items.authors: James R F SUTTON
items.title_zh: 门控量子谐振器：门控驱动耗散量子系统的简化哈密顿网络框架
items.summary_zh: 高维驱动耗散系统通常通过微观描述或简化模型来表征，但其与基础动力学的关系不明确。本文独立于特定分子应用，提出了门控量子谐振器（GQR）作为一种受控的简化表示框架，其中选定的相干坐标受到结构或环境门的调制。保留的坐标由上游建模步骤提供；未引入投影或截断算法。我们从门依赖的哈密顿量出发，发展了互补的模式、网络和端口哈密顿表示，区分了精确保持性质与需要独立验证的现象学闭合。通过GKSL生成器引入开放系统动力学。在无损线性部分，指定的机械网络映射精确保持正常模式频率和模态特征空间，而匹配的输入输出等式是构造上的一致性属性。一个可精确求解的有损三态桥接示例表明，先前提出的耦合-损耗-去相干坐标并未选择普遍的微观传输最优解。因此，该框架将简化模型视为显式机制假设的生成器。

items.title: Accelerating the Design of New Natural Deep Eutectic Solvents with Supervised Variational Autoencoders
items.abstract: The rational design of natural deep eutectic solvents (NaDESs) is hindered by the vast combinatorial space arising from the possible combinations of hydrogen bond donors and acceptors. This enormous design space limits the systematic experimental exploration of their physicochemical properties. In this work, we propose a supervised variational autoencoder (SVAE) framework to efficiently explore this chemical space by coupling generative modeling with property prediction. The model is trained on a curated dataset of deep eutectic solvents to learn simultaneously the latent structural representations and correlations with target properties, including melting point, density, and viscosity. The SVAE generates virtual NaDES candidates characterized by molecular descriptors, component ratios, and target property values. To associate these virtual candidates with real molecules, a descriptor matching strategy is applied using the COCONUT natural product database. The resulting NaDES candidates are subsequently validated using predictive models trained on experimental DES data. The results show strong agreement between the SVAE-generated target property values and the corresponding predictions of the regression models (R2 = 0.89, RMSE=21.7 K for melting point; R2 = 0.91, RMSE = 0.04 g·cm-3 for density; and R2 = 0.89, RMSE=0.47 cP for ln(viscosity)). This workflow demonstrates how guided generative models can be combined with machine learning models to accelerate the discovery of sustainable solvents. Beyond NaDESs, the proposed strategy provides a general and transferable framework for the rational design of other chemical systems, where combinatorial complexity limits conventional experimental approaches.
items.authors: Rachid Laref, Mehdi Oubahmane, Nicolas Rolland, Véronique Nardello-Rataj, Adlane Sayede
items.title_zh: 加速新型天然深共晶溶剂的设计方法研究
items.summary_zh: 天然深共晶溶剂（NaDESs）的合理设计受到氢键供体和受体组合所产生的巨大组合空间的限制，影响了其物理化学性质的系统性实验探索。本文提出了一种监督变分自编码器（SVAE）框架，通过将生成建模与性质预测相结合，来高效探索这一化学空间。模型在经过筛选的深共晶溶剂数据集上训练，以同时学习潜在结构表示及其与目标性质（如熔点、密度和粘度）的相关性。SVAE生成的虚拟NaDES候选物通过分子描述符、组分比例和目标性质值进行表征。利用COCONUT天然产物数据库的描述符匹配策略，将这些虚拟候选物与真实分子关联。随后，使用基于实验DES数据训练的预测模型对生成的NaDES候选物进行验证。结果显示，SVAE生成的目标性质值与回归模型的预测值之间具有良好的一致性（熔点R2 = 0.89，RMSE=21.7 K；密度R2 = 0.91，RMSE = 0.04 g·cm-3；粘度R2 = 0.89，RMSE=0.47 cP for ln）。该工作流程展示了如何指导新型NaDES的设计。

items.title: From Materials to Metalloenzymes: Superconducting Microresonators for Characterization of Thin Films
items.abstract: Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy is a widely used technique for the characterization of paramagnetic centers across a wide range of disciplines. Yet, the detection limits of conventional 3D microwave resonators hinder the application of EPR to nanoscale and magnetically dilute thin films relevant to quantum, catalytic and biological devices. Here we show that high temperature superconducting spiral microresonators fabricated from YBa2Cu3O7-x enable pulse EPR measurements on diverse thin films with a sensitivity improvement of two to three orders of magnitude over commercial resonators. Templated 50 nm films of copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) diluted in metal-free phthalocyanine (H2Pc) deposited onto the microresonator were detectable in echo-detected EPR field sweeps with the templating effect clearly visible from narrowing of the spectrum compared to powder samples. The number of Cu(II) spins present in a single thin film of CuPc on a microresonator with 400 μm diameter was ~1011, as determined by measurement of coherence memory times (Tm) and longitudinal (T1) spin relaxation times. The Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill (CPMG) sequence was also employed, enabling improved SNR by averaging multiple echoes obtained from echo trains. To demonstrate biological application, Cu,Zn superoxide dismutase (SOD) was incorporated into trehalose films of ~3.7 μm average thickness, containing ~1012 Cu(II) centers. Hyperfine spectroscopy (ESEEM and HYSCORE) was successfully performed on the SOD films, producing spectra that match conventional measurements taken with ~104 times more enzyme. These results establish superconducting microresonators as a versatile high-sensitivity platform for pulse EPR of ultrathin and volume-limited films. The transformation of EPR from a ‘bulk’ to a ‘surface’ technique will facilitate the study of quantum materials, catalytic interfaces and bio-integrated devices.
items.authors: Blaise L. Geoghegan, Emma Bryan, Yunfei Dang, Jean-Baptiste Verstraete, Alberto Collauto, Gediminas Usevičius
items.title_zh: 从材料到金属酶：超导微谐振器用于薄膜表征
items.summary_zh: 电子自旋共振（EPR）光谱是一种广泛应用于表征各类顺磁中心的技术。然而，传统三维微波谐振器的检测极限限制了EPR在量子、催化和生物设备相关的纳米尺度和磁性稀薄膜中的应用。本文展示了由YBa2Cu3O7-x制成的高温超导螺旋微谐振器能够进行脉冲EPR测量，其灵敏度比商业谐振器提高了两个到三个数量级。通过模板法制备的50 nm铜酞菁（CuPc）薄膜在无金属酞菁（H2Pc）中稀释，能够在微谐振器上被检测到，回声检测EPR场扫描中模板效应明显，谱线比粉末样品更窄。测得的CuPc薄膜中Cu(II)自旋数量约为1011，利用相干记忆时间（Tm）和纵向自旋弛豫时间（T1）进行测定。此外，采用Carr-Purcell-Meiboom-Gill（CPMG）序列，通过对多个回声进行平均，提高了信噪比。为展示生物应用，将Cu,Zn超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）纳入平均厚度约为3.7 μm的海藻糖薄膜中。

items.title: Advancement of triphos-Ru catalyzed C–O bond disconnections and its challenges
items.abstract: Cured epoxy resins are crosslinked thermoset materials with applications including carbon-or glass-reinforced composites, but whose extensive C–O and C–N bond networks renders recycling challenging. Previously, our group has reported a Ru-triphos-catalyzed system for the chemical deconstruction of amine-cured epoxy resins, enabling recovery of bisphenol A (BPA) under relatively mild conditions. Subsequent mechanistic studies identified slow catalyst activation and catalyst deactivation as key limitations. Herein, these insights were used to develop improved catalytic systems through pre-catalyst and reaction design. Replacement of the original triphos-Ru-TMM pre-catalyst enabled improved catalytic performance, while ligand design enabled the use of H2, instead of isopropanol, as reductant. Despite these advances, the improved performance observed for model compounds did not translate directly to cured epoxy resins. Reaction optimization revealed pronounced dependencies on substrate concentration, and polymer accessibility, while computational studies suggest changes in catalyst speciation imposed by conformational constraints. Together, these findings demonstrate that the bottlenecks governing epoxy-resin deconstruction can change due to constraints imposed by the polymer matrix. The mechanistic insights obtained herein provide a foundation for the development of next-generation thermoset deconstruction strategies.
items.authors: Camille Mandrup Kristensen, Gabriel M. F. Batista, Marcelo H. R. Carvalho, Alexander Ahrens, Clemens Kaussler, Pedro P. de Castro
items.title_zh: 三膦铑催化C–O键断裂的进展及挑战
items.summary_zh: 固化环氧树脂是一种交联的热固性材料，广泛应用于碳纤维或玻璃纤维增强复合材料，但其广泛的C–O和C–N键网络使得回收变得困难。我们小组之前报道了一种铑-三膦催化系统，能够在相对温和的条件下化学解构胺固化的环氧树脂，回收双酚A（BPA）。后续的机理研究发现催化剂激活缓慢和催化剂失活是主要限制因素。本文利用这些见解通过前催化剂和反应设计开发了改进的催化系统。替换原有的三膦铑-TMM前催化剂提高了催化性能，而配体设计则使得可以使用氢气作为还原剂。尽管取得了这些进展，但在模型化合物上观察到的改进性能并未直接转化到固化环氧树脂上。反应优化揭示了对底物浓度和聚合物可及性的显著依赖，而计算研究表明，由于构象限制，催化剂物种的变化影响了反应。综合这些发现表明，影响环氧树脂解构的瓶颈可能因聚合物基体的限制而变化。

items.title: Machine learning-accelerated evolutionary Monte Carlo for rapid phase exploration of compositionally complex materials in reactive environments
items.abstract: Compositionally complex materials, e.g. high-entropy alloys/oxides, have long been of research interest for their unique mechanical and functional properties thanks to the synergistic effects between the large number of components. More recently, they have emerged as a promising platform for the development of novel heterogeneous catalysts for thermo- and electro-chemical applications. However, computational investigation of the phase stability of such catalyst materials remains challenging due to the large design space and the complex active site dynamics under reaction conditions. In this paper, we present a novel evolutionary Monte Carlo algorithm which allows fast exploration of stable compositionally-complex catalyst phases in reactive environments and can be generalized for any catalyst materials and any reaction conditions. In detail, we will showcase that this method can be used in combination with finetuned machine learning potentials for predicting bulk and surface mixing/segregating behaviors of compositionally-complex catalysts under various reaction conditions with reasonable computational cost.
items.authors: Shuang Han, Sandip De
items.title_zh: 机器学习加速的进化蒙特卡洛方法用于复杂材料的相快速探索
items.summary_zh: 组成复杂材料，如高熵合金/氧化物，由于其多组分之间的协同效应，长期以来受到研究者的关注，具有独特的机械和功能特性。近期，这些材料成为开发新型异质催化剂的有前景平台，适用于热化学和电化学应用。然而，由于设计空间大和反应条件下活性位点动态复杂，催化剂材料的相稳定性计算研究仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种新颖的进化蒙特卡洛算法，能够快速探索反应环境中稳定的组成复杂催化剂相，并可推广至任何催化剂材料和反应条件。我们展示了该方法与精调的机器学习势能结合使用，可以在合理的计算成本下预测组成复杂催化剂在不同反应条件下的体相和表面混合/分离行为。

items.title: THIOETHERS AS POTENTIAL ANTIBACTERIAL AGENTS AGAINST METHICILLIN-RESISTANT STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS (MRSA)
items.abstract: The emergence and rapid spread of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) have created an urgent need for new antibacterial agents capable of overcoming established resistance mechanisms. Among the diverse sulfur-containing scaffolds, thioethers have attracted increasing attention because of their structural versatility and ability to modulate antibacterial activity through incorporation into different pharmacophores. This review provides a comprehensive overview of synthetic, semisynthetic, and natural or natural-product-derived thioether compounds evaluated against MRSA, with emphasis on their structural features, structure-activity relationships (SAR), antibacterial potency, and mechanisms of action. The major classes discussed include aminoglycoside-derived thioether amphiphiles, membrane-active small-molecule thioethers, quinazolinone and quinoline thioether scaffolds, pleuromutilin thioether derivatives, SecA-targeting thioethers, chalcone and oxazolidinone derivatives, FtsZ-targeting thioethers, anti-virulence and antibiofilm agents, antimicrobial peptidomimetics, and natural-product-derived thioether compounds. The studies demonstrate that sulfur-containing motifs can contribute to anti-MRSA activity through membrane disruption, inhibition of bacterial protein synthesis and targeting of essential non-ribosomal proteins. The available SAR evidence highlights the scaffold-dependent nature of thioether activity and supports their continued exploration as versatile structural motifs for the development of new therapeutic strategies against drug-resistant MRSA.
items.authors: Aditya G Lavekar, Radha Ahuja, Deepti Gairola
items.title_zh: 硫醚作为抗耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的潜在抗菌剂
items.summary_zh: 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）的出现和快速传播迫切需要新型抗菌剂来克服已有的耐药机制。硫醚因其结构多样性和通过不同药效团的结合调节抗菌活性的能力而受到越来越多的关注。本文综述了合成、半合成及天然或天然产物衍生的硫醚化合物在MRSA中的评估，重点讨论其结构特征、结构-活性关系（SAR）、抗菌效力及作用机制。主要讨论的类别包括氨基糖苷衍生的硫醚两亲分子、膜活性小分子硫醚、喹唑啉酮和喹啉硫醚骨架、Pleuromutilin硫醚衍生物、靶向SecA的硫醚、查尔酮和噁唑烷酮衍生物、靶向FtsZ的硫醚、抗毒力和抗生物膜剂、抗微生物肽模仿物以及天然产物衍生的硫醚化合物。研究表明，含硫基团可以通过破坏膜、抑制细菌蛋白合成及靶向重要的非核糖体蛋白来增强抗MRSA活性。

items.title: Chemoproteomic mapping of active glycan-processing networks in a defined gut microbiome
items.abstract: Microbiome studies typically infer function from gene content or expression, but these measurements do not establish which enzymes are catalytically active or what substrates they recognise. Here we use a multiplexed panel of mechanism-based glycosidase probes to map active glycan-processing enzymes directly from caecal samples of mice colonised with a defined, 14-member, human gut microbiota. Activity-based protein profiling identifies host and microbial enzymes involved in starch, β-glucan, xyloglucan and xylan degradation and links them to defined taxa and loci. Decorated probes resolve branch and substitution preferences within active enzyme families, revealing xylanase activities poorly detected by bulk substrate assays. Several prominent activities are assigned to low-abundance Bacteroides species, while enzyme deployment differs among animals sharing a common inoculum and diet. These results establish activity-based chemoproteomics as a complementary layer to metagenomics, transcriptomics and proteomics for defining functional glycan-processing states in host-associated microbiomes.
items.authors: Isabelle B. Pickles, Thamy L. R. Corrêa, Qinnan Yang, Yurong Chen, Zirui Li, Nicole M. Koropatkin
items.title_zh: 活跃糖基加工网络的化学蛋白组学映射研究
items.summary_zh: 微生物组研究通常通过基因内容或表达推断功能，但这些测量无法确定哪些酶具有催化活性或识别哪些底物。本研究使用多重机制基础的糖苷酶探针，从定殖有14种人类肠道微生物的鼠盲肠样本中直接绘制活跃的糖基加工酶。基于活性的蛋白质谱分析识别出参与淀粉、β-葡聚糖、木聚糖和木糖降解的宿主和微生物酶，并将其与特定分类群和位点关联。装饰探针解析了活跃酶家族中的支链和取代偏好，揭示了通过大宗底物测定难以检测的木糖酶活性。多个显著活性被分配给低丰度的拟杆菌属物种，而共享相同接种物和饮食的动物之间酶的使用存在差异。这些结果确立了基于活性的化学蛋白组学作为补充层次，与宏基因组学、转录组学和蛋白质组学共同定义宿主相关微生物组中的功能性糖基加工状态。

items.title: alchemy: systematic enumeration and thermodynamic screening of small-molecule radical reaction networks
items.abstract: Automated construction of chemical reaction networks is limited by the combinatorial growth of possible molecules, intermediates, and formal transformations. We present alchemy, an open-source Python workflow for systematic enumeration and screening of small-molecule radical reaction networks. Within an explicitly bounded graph space, alchemy generates connected, neutral C/N/H molecular graphs with single, double, or triple bonds and specified radical counts; RDKit sanitisation and canonicalisation then remove graph-invalid and duplicate records. Reaction candidates are constructed without learned reaction templates by combining bond-dissociation records into rearrangement and transfer stoichiometries. Parallel generation, disk-backed storage, machine-learning prediction of molecular Gibbs free energies, and Kuzu graph representation make the resulting formal network searchable. In a trimethylamine case study limited to at most five heavy atoms and one unpaired electron per reaction side, the workflow generated 41,735 unique molecular graphs and 60,035 first-generation radical-transfer records. A PaiNN model trained and tested on OpenBabel-generated QM9 geometries supplies rapid ranking scores, but QM9 contains no open-shell species and therefore cannot validate predictions for the radical chemistry enumerated here. alchemy therefore provides a reproducible route to efficient reaction-space enumeration while retaining practical filters for chemical plausibility and downstream mechanistic analysis.
items.authors: Le Minh Vu, Priya Sharmesh, Mega Kar, Truyen Tran, Sherif Abdulkader Tawfik
items.title_zh: alchemy：小分子自由基反应网络的系统枚举与热力学筛选
items.summary_zh: 自动构建化学反应网络受到可能分子、中间体和形式转化的组合增长限制。我们提出了alchemy，一个开源Python工作流程，用于系统枚举和筛选小分子自由基反应网络。在明确界定的图空间内，alchemy生成连接的、带有单、双或三键及指定自由基数量的中性C/N/H分子图；RDKit的消毒和标准化步骤则去除无效图和重复记录。反应候选通过结合键解离记录构建，而无需学习反应模板。并行生成、磁盘存储、分子吉布斯自由能的机器学习预测以及Kuzu图表示使得生成的正式网络可搜索。在一个以三甲胺为案例的研究中，工作流程生成了41,735个独特的分子图和60,035个第一代自由基转移记录。虽然训练和测试于OpenBabel生成的QM9几何结构的PaiNN模型提供了快速排名分数，但QM9不包含开壳物种，因此无法验证此处枚举的自由基化学的预测。因此，alchemy提供了一条可重复的高效研究路径。

items.title: Directed Evolution of a Non-Heme Iron Enzyme for Enantioselective Dearomative Nitrene Transfer: Synthesis of 3a-Aminopyrroloindoline Alkaloids
items.abstract: Enzymatic nitrene-induced dearomatization represents an unexplored area of biocatalytic reactivity. Here, we report the directed evolution of AsqJ, a non-heme iron enzyme from aspoquinolone biosynthesis, to catalyze the first biocatalytic asymmetric dearomative nitrene transfer into indoles to furnish enantioenriched 3a-aminopyrroloindolines — a privileged scaffold in bioactive indole alkaloid natural products. Obtained through iterative semi-rational engineering and structure-informed mutagenesis, the final variant achieves up to 98% yield and 99% ee. The reaction accommodates a range of indole substrates, affording up to 86% isolated yield on preparative scale with consistently high enantioselectivity. Molecular dynamics simulations suggest that directed evolution established a new substrate-binding conformation that is distinct from the starting variant through a reorganized hydrogen-bonding network within a more preorganized active site. The synthetic utility of this platform is demonstrated through the total syntheses of two natural products, (+)-psychotriasine and (+)-psychotrimine. This work establishes asymmetric dearomative nitrene transfer as a new biocatalytic modality, extends the catalytic repertoire of non-heme iron enzymes to encompass asymmetric dearomatization, and provides a foundation for applying new-to-nature biocatalytic reactions in complex natural product synthesis.
items.authors: Xinpeng Mu, Ruiying Jiang, Jiali Xie, Shu Li, Hans Renata
items.title_zh: 非血红素铁酶的定向进化用于对映选择性去芳香化氮转移
items.summary_zh: 氨基氮诱导的去芳香化酶促反应是生物催化反应中尚未探索的领域。本研究报告了非血红素铁酶AsqJ的定向进化，首次催化了不对称去芳香化氮转移至吲哚，合成了富含对映体的3a-氨基吡咯并吲哚类生物碱。通过迭代半理性工程和结构导向的突变，最终变体实现了高达98%的产率和99%的对映体过量。该反应适用于多种吲哚底物，在制备规模上获得高达86%的分离产率，并保持一致的高对映选择性。分子动力学模拟表明，定向进化建立了一种新的底物结合构象，与起始变体不同，活性位点内的氢键网络重新组织。该平台的合成实用性通过两种天然产物（(+)-psychotriasine和(+)-psychotrimine）的全合成得以验证。此研究确立了不对称去芳香化氮转移作为一种新的生物催化模式，扩展了非血红素铁酶的催化能力，为在复杂天然产物中应用新型生物催化反应奠定了基础。

items.title: Paving the Way Towards a Compact Complete Chiroptical Toolbox
items.abstract: Circularly polarised luminescence (CPL) spectroscopy is a technique with applications in materials chemistry, bioimaging, probing fundamental chirality, but conventional photo-elastic modulator CPL instruments remain bulky, expensive and slow. We report a compact single-channel CPL (SC-CPL) spectrometer that alternates left-and righthanded emission through a piezo-actuated pair of orthogonally aligned achromatic quarter-wave plates using a rapid CCD detector. This design minimises moving optics and eliminates the need for detector matching and pre-calibration. It can operate in various acquisition modes such as time gated acquisition mode for long-lived CPL emission and a quasi-continuous mode for short-lived CPL emission. Validation against a benchmark PEM-CPL system using a range of CPL emitters reproduced fine CPL resolution with high sensitivity, orders of magnitude faster. This blueprint SC-CPL reported herein paves the way towards the world's first complete compact chiroptical toolbox. This could lead to significant advancements with pivotal scientific and societal impact.
items.authors: Dominic J Black, Artemijs Krimovs, Robert Pal
items.title_zh: 构建紧凑型完整手性光学工具箱的基础
items.summary_zh: 圆偏振光致发光（CPL）光谱是一种在材料化学、生物成像和探测基本手性方面具有应用的技术，但传统的光弹调制器CPL仪器体积庞大、价格昂贵且速度较慢。我们报告了一种紧凑型单通道CPL（SC-CPL）光谱仪，该仪器通过一个快速CCD探测器，利用压电驱动的正交对齐的无色差四分之一波片交替左、右手发射。该设计最小化了运动光学，消除了探测器匹配和预校准的需求。它可以在多种采集模式下运行，如用于长寿命CPL发射的时间门控采集模式和用于短寿命CPL发射的准连续模式。与基准PEM-CPL系统的验证显示，该系统在高灵敏度下以数个数量级更快的速度再现了精细的CPL分辨率。本文所报告的SC-CPL蓝图为世界首个完整紧凑型手性光学工具箱铺平了道路，可能带来具有重要科学和社会影响的显著进展。

items.title: Environmental benefits and trade-offs of dry coating for battery electrode production
items.abstract: Dry coating is an emerging, scalable alternative to traditional slurry coating for manufacturing lithium-ion battery electrodes. It offers significant energy savings, eliminates the need for toxic solvents, and is consequently often regarded as an environmentally more benign process. Dry coating exploits the fibrillating properties of polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), substituting the polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder employed in slurry coating. As replacing slurry coating with dry coating involves different production processes and materials, a comprehensive life cycle assessment (LCA) study was performed for an accurate comparison of the environmental impacts. The results of our LCA show that dry coating has the potential to reduce environmental impacts across all assessed impact categories except for the ozone depletion potential, which increases by a factor of 1.8 when PVDF is replaced by an equal mass of PTFE. For LiNi 0.8 Mn 0.1 Co 0.1 O₂ (NMC811) cathodes, dry coating typically enables a reduction in binder content by a factor of two, which offsets the higher ozone depletion potential of PTFE with respect to PVDF and results in a comparable impact at cell level. For LiFePO 4 (LFP) cathodes and graphite anodes, state-of-the-art processing relies on aqueous, non-fluorinated binders, typically a combination of carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR). Dry coating therefore introduces PTFE into a process that is currently free of fluorinated materials, lowering CO 2 emissions but increasing ozone depleting emissions. We also highlight knowledge and data gaps associated with the polymerization of PVDF and PTFE, which currently prevent a robust comparison of toxicity-related impact categories, and discuss the potential of non-fluorinated binders for dry coating. Overall, our study provides a foundation for understanding environmental benefits, trade-offs, and remaining data gaps identified for dry coating technologies, supporting informed decisions on their future development and scalable implementation in lithium-ion battery manufacturing.
items.authors: Martina Serra, Edouard Quérel, Eleonora Crenna, Stefan Reimann, Martin K. Vollmer, Zhanyun Wang
items.title_zh: 干涂层在电池电极生产中的环境效益与权衡
items.summary_zh: 干涂层是一种新兴的、可扩展的锂离子电池电极制造替代方案，取代传统的浆料涂层。该方法显著节能，消除了对有毒溶剂的需求，因此被认为是一种更环保的工艺。干涂层利用聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）的纤维化特性，替代浆料涂层中使用的聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）粘合剂。由于干涂层与浆料涂层涉及不同的生产工艺和材料，进行了全面的生命周期评估（LCA）以准确比较环境影响。LCA结果显示，干涂层在所有评估的影响类别中都有潜在的环境影响减少，唯独臭氧消耗潜力增加1.8倍。对于LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O₂（NMC811）阴极，干涂层通常使粘合剂含量减少一半，抵消了PTFE相对于PVDF的臭氧消耗潜力，从而在电池级别上产生可比的影响。对于LiFePO4（LFP）阴极和石墨阳极，先进的加工依赖于水性非氟化粘合剂，通常是羧甲基纤维素（CMC）和苯乙烯-丁二烯橡胶（SB）的组合。

items.title: Entropy-Guided Dataset Reduction for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
items.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) deliver near-quantum-mechanical accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. Their performance depends on the quality and composition of the training data: the training set must cover the range of atomic environments the model will encounter, yet unnecessary redundancy increases training cost without improving accuracy and can inadvertently introduce training biases. Dataset pruning (i.e., selecting a compact, representative subset from a larger collection) has emerged as a practical strategy for building high-quality training sets. Recently, methods based on informationtheoretic diversity measures such as QUESTS (Quick Uncertainty and Entropy from STructural Similarity) have shown significant promise, however, QUESTS requires specification of a lengthscale parameter (kernel bandwidth) that controls how similar two atomic environments must be before one is considered redundant. We show that operationally useful values of this parameter vary across structurally distinct phases, making naive automated pruning of heterogeneous datasets challenging. We present a pruning framework that addresses this problem by adapting the bandwidth independently for distinct thermodynamic subsets of the training dataset using an automatable elbow criterion applied to QUESTS informationentropy metrics. Farthest-point sampling (FPS) is then applied within each group to select maximally diverse atomic environments. Using the Small Carbon ChIMES 2.0 dataset comprising diamond, graphite, and liquid carbon spanning a broad range of thermodynamic conditions, we show that use of a single global bandwidth yields pruned datasets that can be strongly dominated by a single phase, particularly when the distribution of environments varies significantly between phases (e.g., liquid vs crystalline).1,2 Relative to global pruning at the same retained fraction, group-aware adaptive pruning reduces test force-MAE by up to 37% for diamond and 26% for graphite for models trained on only 5% of the original training data, with corresponding improvements in radial distribution function (RDF) fidelity. Benefits are smaller in structurally heterogeneous conditions where a single thermodynamic label encompasses multiple distinct local bonding environments with different characteristic length scales, indicating that finer grouping is the natural remedy in such regimes. Across crystalline conditions, the elbow-selected bandwidth aligns with the onset of rapid error growth as the dataset is pruned, providing a practical, model-agnostic guide for pruning decisions that requires no model training.
items.authors: Benjamin R. Laubach, Joshua A. Vita, Kyle Bushick, Logan Williams, Vincenzo Lordi, Rebecca K. Lindsey
items.title_zh: 基于熵引导的数据集缩减用于机器学习原子势
items.summary_zh: 机器学习原子势（MLIPs）以较低的计算成本提供接近量子力学的精度，其性能依赖于训练数据的质量和组成。训练集必须覆盖模型将遇到的原子环境范围，但不必要的冗余会增加训练成本而不提高准确性，并可能引入训练偏差。数据集修剪（即从较大集合中选择紧凑、具有代表性的子集）已成为构建高质量训练集的实用策略。基于信息论多样性度量的方法如QUESTS（快速不确定性和熵来自结构相似性）显示出显著前景，但QUESTS需要指定控制原子环境相似性的长度尺度参数。我们展示了该参数在不同结构相位中的有效值差异，使得对异质数据集的简单自动修剪变得具有挑战性。我们提出了一种修剪框架，通过对训练数据集的不同热力学子集独立调整带宽，使用可自动化的肘部标准应用于QUESTS信息熵度量，从而解决这一问题。随后应用最远点采样（FPS）。

items.title: Applicability-Domain-Aware Evaluation of Machine-Learning NMR Chemical-Shift Prediction in Small drug Molecules: GT-NMR for 13C and CASCADE for 1H

items.authors: Diba Allameh Zadeh
items.title_zh: 机器学习NMR化学位移预测的适用性领域评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究对两种预训练的机器学习模型在五种药物相关小分子（氨基甲酸酯、苯佐卡因、多巴胺、贝他唑和贝他组胺）中的溶液态NMR化学位移预测的实际准确性和适用性领域进行了小规模外部评估。使用预训练的GT-NMR图形变换模型进行特定原子13C化学位移预测，CASCADE 3D图神经网络工作流程用于1H化学位移预测。通过与可验证的文献NMR数据进行比较，评估了数据集重叠、最近训练集Morgan指纹Tanimoto相似度、Murcko骨架覆盖率和分子复杂性作为适用性领域诊断。检查的GT-NMR或CASCADE质子训练/验证/测试部分未检测到五种确切结构，但所有五种Murcko骨架在相应的训练集中都有代表。GT-NMR的审核13C分子级平均绝对误差为苯佐卡因0.50 ppm。

items.title: A Bipolar Redox Metal-Organic Framework for Metal-Conversion-Free Symmetric Halide-Ion Batteries
items.abstract: Rechargeable batteries predominantly rely on cation intercalation or metal conversion reactions, which often suffer from structural degradation, limited reversibility, and safety concerns. We report a symmetric halide-ion battery based on a bipolar redox metal-organic framework (MOF), in which energy storage is governed by reversible intraframework halogenation rather than metal--halide conversion chemistry. The bipolar redox chemistry of the μ 3 -oxo-bridged trinuclear copper centres in the MOF enables reversible halogenation and dehalogenation, allowing identical electrodes consisting of MOF microcrystals embedded within binder-free carbon nanotube (CNT) films to function as either cathode or anode depending on the halide species involved. Operando Raman spectroelectrochemistry reveals the underlying redox mechanism, while density-functional theory (DFT) suggests a thermodynamic preference for bromination over chlorination, rationalising the framework's dual functionality. In a symmetric configuration using a mixture of chloride- and bromide-based neat ionic liquids, the cell reaches a specific capacity of 68.7 mAh g -1 and an energy density of 35.4 Wh kg -1 under extended charging conditions. The cell operates for more than 200 charge--discharge cycles under repeated short-charge cycling. This non-flammable, moisture-resistant system composed entirely of earth-abundant elements highlights the potential of redox-active MOFs for alternative battery chemistries.
items.authors: Danial Kohminaei, Shiraz Ahmed Siddiqui, Alexander Prado-Roller, Hidetsugu Shiozawa
items.title_zh: 一种双极性红氧还原金属有机框架的对称卤化物离子电池
