items.summary_zh: 可充电电池主要依赖阳离子插层或金属转化反应，常面临结构降解、有限的可逆性和安全隐患。我们报道了一种基于双极性红氧还原金属有机框架（MOF）的对称卤化物离子电池，其能量存储由可逆的框架内卤素化过程主导，而非金属-卤化物转化化学。MOF中μ3-氧桥三核铜中心的双极性红氧还原化学使得卤素化和脱卤素化可逆进行，允许由嵌入无粘合剂碳纳米管（CNT）薄膜的MOF微晶组成的相同电极根据所涉及的卤化物种类作为阴极或阳极。光谱电化学揭示了基础的红氧还原机制，而密度泛函理论（DFT）表明溴化相较于氯化具有热力学偏好，合理化了框架的双重功能。在使用氯化物和溴化物混合的纯离子液体的对称配置中，电池在延长充电条件下达到68.7 mAh g-1的比容量和35.4 Wh kg-1的能量密度。该电池在重复短充电循环下运行超过200个充放电周期。该系统由丰富的地球元素组成，具有不易燃和耐潮湿的特性。

items.title: An Attention-based Architecture to Decode Chemical Transformations from Process Spectroscopic Data
items.abstract: Spectroscopy is a powerful analytical technique that promises precise characterization of chemical species and their transformations in dynamic chemical processes. Traditionally, spectral signatures are interpreted by calibrating against established spectral libraries. However, for complex molecular systems, mixtures of multiple interacting compounds, or dynamical processes, the resulting spectral signals become highly convoluted. Conventional deconvolution based methods rely on the availability of prior information to effectively decompose the measured data into latent components and infer chemical transformations using plausible reaction templates. However, the dynamics, scale, and dimensionality of process spectroscopic data make such deconvolutions increasingly difficult and often ill-conditioned. These limitations are particularly pronounced in industrial process settings, thus reducing their effectiveness for quality control, impurity detection, and reaction pathway identification. Towards the precise and automated elucidation of chemical transformations, we introduce an attention-based decoder architecture that not only mines the chemical transformations from high-dimensional process spectroscopic data but also facilitates the identification of key participating species without requiring prior knowledge of the reaction template, the number of participating species, or their initial profiles. We employ a spectral-specific learnable embedding that enhances the extraction of informative spectral features, thereby improving inference quality while reducing computational cost. Model inference involves monitoring attention weights through the proposed focal-score metric and identifying the underlying causal template using asymmetry-based directed acyclic graph (DAG) estimation. The correlation of focal scores along the spectral dimension facilitates the identification of participating species, whereas correlation along the transformation coordinate highlights the underlying transformation events. Thus, the proposed framework highlights the underlying chemical transformations encoded in the spectroscopic data while providing interpretability to the proposed decoder model. The efficacy of the developed method is demonstrated on systems comprising multiple chemical compounds undergoing several transformation steps, including the formation of short-lived intermediates and the presence of chemically similar species. The proposed framework not only enhances the interpretability of spectral data but also paves the way for integrating diverse spectroscopic datasets for comprehensive molecular analysis.
items.authors: Kuldeep Singh, Vinay Prasad
items.title_zh: 基于注意力机制的化学转化解码架构
items.summary_zh: 光谱学是一种强大的分析技术，能够精确表征化学物质及其在动态化学过程中的转化。传统上，光谱特征通过与已建立的光谱库进行校准来解释。然而，对于复杂的分子系统、多种相互作用化合物的混合物或动态过程，得到的光谱信号变得高度复杂。传统的去卷积方法依赖于先验信息，以有效地将测量数据分解为潜在成分，并使用合理的反应模板推断化学转化。然而，过程光谱数据的动态性、规模和维度使得这种去卷积变得越来越困难，且常常不适定。这些限制在工业过程环境中尤为明显，从而降低了其在质量控制、杂质检测和反应路径识别中的有效性。为实现化学转化的精确自动阐明，我们提出了一种基于注意力机制的解码器架构，能够从高维过程光谱数据中挖掘化学转化，并识别关键参与物种，而无需先验的反应模板、参与物种数量或其他信息。

items.title: High-pressure allotropes of tellurium: Evolutionary structure prediction
items.abstract: The high-pressure structural evolution of elemental tellurium in the 30–400 GPa range has been systematically investigated using the USPEX evolutionary algorithm combined with first-principles density functional theory calculations. The constructed enthalpy–pressure diagram reveals a previously unresolved phase transition sequence Im-3m → I4/mmm (P63/mmc) → Fm-3m that reconciles long-standing discrepancies in the literature. The body-centered cubic Im-3m allotrope was identified as the thermodynamically stable ground state from 30 to 290 GPa. Above 290 GPa, it becomes energetically unfavorable, yielding to two competitive lower-symmetry structures: I4/mmm (stable) and P63/mmc (low-energy metastable). A distinct crossover occurs at 330 GPa, stabilizing the dense face-centered cubic Fm-3m allotrope. The results provide a definitive structural framework for understanding the pressure-dependent properties of tellurium, and a fertile ground for exploring the intricate interplay between crystal structure, electronic topology, and emergent quantum phenomena in elemental systems under pressure.
items.authors: Vladimir L. Solozhenko
items.title_zh: 高压下碲的同素异形体：进化结构预测
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统探讨了元素碲在30–400 GPa范围内的高压结构演变，采用USPEX进化算法结合第一性原理密度泛函理论计算。构建的焓-压力图揭示了一个之前未解决的相变序列Im-3m → I4/mmm (P63/mmc) → Fm-3m，解决了文献中长期存在的争议。体心立方Im-3m同素异形体在30至290 GPa范围内被确定为热力学稳定的基态。超过290 GPa后，其能量变得不利，转而形成两种竞争的低对称性结构：I4/mmm（稳定）和P63/mmc（低能亚稳态）。在330 GPa时发生明显的交叉，稳定了密集的面心立方Fm-3m同素异形体。研究结果为理解碲的压力依赖特性提供了明确的结构框架，并为探索元素系统在压力下的晶体结构、电子拓扑和新兴量子现象之间的复杂相互作用提供了丰富的基础。

items.title: Chemical Accuracy for Carbapenem Breakdown by Class A beta-Lactamases Using a Transferable Embedded Machine-Learned Potential
items.abstract: Bacterial resistance to carbapenems (potent β-lactam antibiotics) is a critical global health threat. The primary cause is β-lactamase enzymes that hydrolyze antibiotics. Previously, carbapenems resisted breakdown, making them ‘last resort’ antibiotics, but enzymes with carbapenemase activity have become widespread. Understanding and predicting the activity of β-lactamases will help in developing antibiotics and inhibitors, and combating antibiotic resistance. Effective prediction requires methods that are both accurate and computationally efficient. Multiscale combined quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) molecular dynamics simulations of reactions can discriminate between class A β-lactamases (the most widely distributed group) with or without carbapenemase activity, and identify determinants of activity. but face an accuracy/efficiency tradeoff: approximate semiempirical QM methods do not predict reaction barriers accurately, but higher level QM calculations require extensive computer time and resources, making them impractical for rapid predictions. Here, we develop and test a transferable ML/MM framework for the deacylation reaction of the carbapenem meropenem, using the electrostatic machine learning embedding (EMLE) scheme. This model gives free energy barriers to within 1 kcal/mol of values derived from experiment, for four different class A β-lactamases. Crucially, the model was trained only on active site structures from QM/MM simulations of a single enzyme. It did not require retraining to generalize across Class A β-lactamases. It is both faster and more accurate than semi-empirical QM/MM simulations. The ML/MM simulations capture the structural and electrostatic determinants of carbapenemase activity, including oxyanion stabilization and active site electric fields, that differ between enzymes. This work establishes transferable EMLE-based ML/MM simulation as a practical route for accurate, efficient modelling of enzyme-catalyzed reactions.
items.authors: Elliot W. Chan, Michael Beer, Kirill Zinovjev, James Spencer, Marc W. van der Kamp, Adrian J. Mulholland
items.title_zh: 利用可转移的嵌入式机器学习势研究类A β-内酰胺酶对碳青霉烯的降解
items.summary_zh: 细菌对碳青霉烯（强效β-内酰胺抗生素）的耐药性是全球健康的重大威胁，主要原因是β-内酰胺酶的水解作用。碳青霉烯曾被认为是“最后的救命稻草”，但具有碳青霉烯酶活性的酶已广泛传播。理解和预测β-内酰胺酶的活性有助于开发新抗生素和抑制剂，抵抗抗生素耐药性。有效的预测需要准确且计算高效的方法。我们开发并测试了一种可转移的机器学习/分子力学框架，研究碳青霉烯美洛培南的去酰化反应，采用电静态机器学习嵌入（EMLE）方案。该模型对四种不同类A β-内酰胺酶的自由能障碍的预测误差在1 kcal/mol以内，与实验值相符。

items.title: Hypermolecule: Chemically Synthesized Three-dimensional Macroscopic Molecular Moiré Superlattices
items.abstract: Recently, moiré superlattices in two-dimensional (2D) systems have attracted significant attention owing to their tunable optical, electronic and quantum properties. Nevertheless, the studies of moiré systems were mostly limited to 2D systems, which make scalability and reproducibility an important issue. Here, we report evidence for the formation of moleculebased macroscopic three-dimensional (3D) moiré superlattice superstructure. We define the isolated 3D assembly as a hypermolecule that has no known natural or synthetic molecular analogue. The time-dependent evolution of the 2D moiré assemblies was investigated using transmission electron microscopy, UV-visible spectroscopy and photoluminescence studies, revealing the hierarchical progression of twist-stacked 2D moiré superlattices towards the growth of macroscopic moiré systems. In addition, X-ray diffraction characterization methods were pursued to elucidate the structural characteristics of the resulting 3D assemblies and establish the correlation between the 2D and 3D superlattices. The macroscopic moiré superlattices – in addition to the 2D structures – exhibited chiroptical behavior, which was further investigated using circularly polarized luminescence study. These observations provide essential insights, and an open platform for further developments in pursuing deeper mechanism underlying their formation at the molecular level and their application potential.
items.authors: Ashmita Mishra, Archismita Hajra, Arun Chattopadhyay
items.title_zh: 超分子：化学合成的三维宏观分子莫尔超晶格
items.summary_zh: 近年来，二维系统中的莫尔超晶格因其可调的光学、电子和量子特性而受到广泛关注。然而，莫尔系统的研究主要限于二维系统，导致可扩展性和可重复性成为重要问题。本文报道了基于分子的宏观三维莫尔超晶格超结构的形成证据。我们将这种孤立的三维组装定义为超分子，其没有已知的自然或合成分子类比。通过透射电子显微镜、紫外-可见光谱和光致发光研究，探讨了二维莫尔组装的时间依赖性演变，揭示了扭转堆叠的二维莫尔超晶格向宏观莫尔系统生长的层次进展。此外，采用X射线衍射表征方法阐明了所得到的三维组装的结构特征，并建立了二维与三维超晶格之间的关联。宏观莫尔超晶格除了二维结构外，还表现出手性光学行为，进一步通过圆偏振光致发光研究进行了探讨。这些观察为深入理解其形成机制提供了重要见解和开放平台。

items.title: Bridging MS2 Spectra and Chemical Space: Advances in Spectral Similarity, Molecular Retrieval, and De Novo Structure Discovery
items.abstract: Mass spectrometry-based metabolomics increasingly relies on computational methods to translate information-rich MS/MS fragmentation patterns into chemical insight, yet assigning chemical identities to spectra ("annotation") remains a major bottleneck because reference libraries cover only a small fraction of plausible compounds. In this review, we frame the field through the lens of two interacting representation spaces: spectral space, where MS/MS data reside, and chemical space, where molecules are represented by fingerprints, descriptors, or learned embeddings. We discuss how different design choices induce different geometries, what it means for spectra or molecules to be "close", and survey methods for representing and comparing spectra, representing molecules, and mapping between both spaces. We highlight emerging deep-learning trends for cross-modal alignment and retrieval, and we outline where the analogy to text-image learning breaks due to peak ambiguity, noise, and the one-to-many nature of spectrum-to-structure relationships.
items.authors: Julian Pollmann, Roman Bushuiev, Anton Bushuiev, Tomáš Pluskal, Florian Huber
items.title_zh: 连接MS2光谱与化学空间：光谱相似性与分子检索进展
items.summary_zh: 基于质谱的代谢组学日益依赖计算方法将信息丰富的MS/MS碎片化模式转化为化学洞察，但由于参考库仅覆盖少量可能化合物，光谱的化学身份分配（“注释”）仍是主要瓶颈。本文通过光谱空间和化学空间两个交互的表示空间框架来探讨该领域，前者包含MS/MS数据，后者通过指纹、描述符或学习嵌入表示分子。我们讨论了不同设计选择如何引发不同几何形态，以及光谱或分子“接近”的含义，并概述了光谱表示与比较、分子表示及两者之间映射的方法。我们强调了跨模态对齐和检索的新兴深度学习趋势，并指出由于峰值歧义、噪声和光谱与结构关系的一对多特性，文本-图像学习的类比在何处失效。

items.title: Magnetic anisotropy of tellurium(I) and selenium(I)† in a Li3N host crystal
items.abstract: Magnetic anisotropy in low-coordinate main-group compounds has recently emerged as a promising route toward realizing single-molecule magnet behavior beyond traditional transition-metal and lanthanide systems. In this work, we investigate the electronic structure and magnetic properties of selenium-and tellurium-doped Li3N crystals using a combination of periodic density functional theory and embedded ionic-crystal QM/MM multireference calculations. Substitution of Li(1) sites by Se(I) and Te(I) generates low-coordinate np3 configurations embedded in a highly symmetric crystalline environment. Periodic calculations reveal substantial differences in spin localization and covalency between the two dopants: Te-doping stabilizes a spin-polarized electronic structure with localized magnetic character, whereas stronger Se 4p–N 2p hybridization leads to increased delocalization and a non-magnetic DFT ground state. Multireference SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2 calculations show that both systems possess magnetically isotropic ground states dominated by a singly occupied σ bonding orbital, while the first excited states exhibit pronounced axial magnetic anisotropy arising from nearly degenerate π∗ x and π∗ y orbitals coupled through spin–orbit interaction. For Te-doped clusters, extremely small transverse g-tensor components (gx,gy ≈ 0.002) and large axial components (gz ≈ 3.9) indicate near-ideal magnetic axiality, slightly stronger than in the Se analogues. The larger spin–orbit coupling of tellurium also produces significantly enhanced spin–orbit splitting relative to selenium. These results demonstrate that heavy main-group elements embedded in suitable low-coordinate environments can support highly anisotropic magnetic states and further support theoretical design principles for main-group single-molecule magnets.
items.authors: Dániel Nagy, Akseli Mansikkamäki
items.title_zh: 锂氮宿主晶体中碲(I)和硒(I)的磁各向异性研究
items.summary_zh: 低配位主族化合物中的磁各向异性最近被认为是实现单分子磁体行为的有前景途径。本研究采用周期性密度泛函理论和嵌入离子晶体的量子力学/分子力学多重参考计算，探讨了掺硒和掺碲的Li3N晶体的电子结构和磁性。Li(1)位点被Se(I)和Te(I)替代后，形成了嵌入高度对称晶体环境的低配位np3构型。计算结果显示，两种掺杂剂在自旋局域化和共价性方面存在显著差异：Te掺杂稳定了具有局域磁性的自旋极化电子结构，而Se 4p–N 2p的强杂化导致了更强的去局域化和非磁性的DFT基态。多重参考SA-CASSCF/NEVPT2计算表明，两种体系均具有以单占σ键轨道为主导的磁各向同性基态，而第一激发态则表现出明显的轴向磁各向异性，源于通过自旋-轨道相互作用耦合的近简并π∗ x和π∗ y轨道。对于掺碲的簇，极小的横向g张量分量（gx,gy ≈ 0.002）和较大的轴向分量（gz ≈ 3.9）表明接近理想的磁各向异性。

items.title: Digestion and Orthogonal Click Conjugation Enables Nanopore Reading of Proteins
items.abstract: Accurate characterization of bioactive peptides and proteins is needed to fully understand the origin of their activity. Nanopore reading enables polypeptide characterization at the single-molecule level. Here we describe a digestion-ligation method based on readily available reagents and benchtop equipment to convert peptides and proteins into DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates that can be analyzed by nanopores. Chymotrypsin digestion yields peptide fragments with C-terminal tyrosine residues suitable for oxidation-induced click chemistry. Subsequent selective installation of an azide on the N terminus enables installation of a template DNA strand needed for nanopore reading. The findings provide a facile approach to prepare DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates that has great potential for applicability to nanopore reading of many proteins.
items.authors: Jasper W. van de Sande, Xiuqi Chen, Cees Dekker, Bauke Albada
items.title_zh: 消化与正交点击结合实现蛋白质的纳米孔读取
items.summary_zh: 为了全面理解生物活性肽和蛋白质的活性来源，准确表征其特性至关重要。纳米孔读取技术能够在单分子水平上对多肽进行表征。本文描述了一种基于常用试剂和台式设备的消化-连接方法，将肽和蛋白质转化为可通过纳米孔分析的DNA-肽-DNA结合物。使用胰凝乳蛋白酶消化可获得适合氧化诱导点击化学的C末端酪氨酸残基的肽片段。随后，在N末端选择性安装叠氮化物，便于安装纳米孔读取所需的模板DNA链。研究结果提供了一种简便的方法来制备DNA-肽-DNA结合物，具有广泛应用于多种蛋白质的纳米孔读取的潜力。

items.title: Investigating Segregation Effects in Mixture Adsorption in Mordenite Zeolite Using Monte-Carlo Simulations
items.abstract: Configurational-Bias Monte Carlo (CBMC) simulations have been used to investigate segregation effects for adsorption of CO2(1)/CH4(2) and CO2(1)/C3H8(2) mixtures in Mordenite (MOR) zeolite. The segregation effects originate from the preferential location of CO2 in the 8-ring side pockets, and C3H8 in the 12-ring 1D channels; the CH4 molecules locate at both these sites. The segregated nature of mixture adsorption causes the quantitative failure of the Ideal Adsorbed Solution Theory (IAST) that mandates a uniform distribution of guest adsorbates in the zeolite framework. For CO2(1)/C3H8(2) mixtures, thermodynamic non-idealities cause selectivity reversals and azeotropic adsorption. Quantitative match with CBMC data is achieved by introduction of activity coefficients and use of the Real Adsorbed Solution Theory (RAST). The experimental data of Talu and Zwiebel (A.I.Ch.E.J. 32, 1263-1276, 1986) for CO2/C3H8 mixture adsorption in H-MOR are in remarkable agreement with the corresponding CBMC simulation data. The phenomenon of azeotropic adsorption occurs at the same composition in both data sets. The PN-DPL model of Ritter (Langmuir 27, 4700-4712, 2011) is able to anticipate the selectivity reversal phenomena. However, the PN-DPL model fails to match CBMC and experimental data at increased pore occupancies because entropy effects that favor CO2 are not properly catered for by the Ritter model.
items.authors: Rajamani Krishna, Jasper M. van Baten
items.title_zh: 利用蒙特卡洛模拟研究莫尔登石沸石中混合物吸附的分离效应
items.summary_zh: 本文采用构型偏置蒙特卡洛（CBMC）模拟研究了CO2(1)/CH4(2)和CO2(1)/C3H8(2)混合物在莫尔登石（MOR）沸石中的吸附分离效应。分离效应源于CO2优先位于8环侧口，而C3H8则位于12环一维通道中，CH4分子则分布于这两个位置。混合物吸附的分离特性导致理想吸附溶液理论（IAST）在定量上的失效。对于CO2(1)/C3H8(2)混合物，热力学非理想性引起选择性反转和共沸吸附。通过引入活度系数和使用真实吸附溶液理论（RAST），实现了与CBMC数据的定量匹配。Talu和Zwiebel的实验数据与CBMC模拟数据高度一致，共沸吸附现象在两个数据集中发生在相同组成。Ritter的PN-DPL模型能够预测选择性反转现象，但在孔隙占用率增加时未能匹配CBMC和实验数据，因为未能妥善考虑有利于CO2的熵效应。

items.title: Decoupling Morphological and Electronic Effects of Ni-Doped Ruthenium Oxide Oxygen Evolution Catalysts for PEM Water Electrolysis
items.abstract: Proper assessment of oxygen evolution reaction (OER) catalyst performance requires recognising that doping can introduce simultaneous changes to structure, morphology, and electronic properties that together influence the observed electrochemical behaviour. In this study, Ni-doped RuO2 is used as a model system to systematically investigate how dopant concentration and synthesis temperature affect catalyst morphology and electronic structure. These trends are correlated with OER mass activity (MA), intrinsic activity, and stability enabling the morphological and intrinsic electronic contributions to catalyst performance to be distinguished. The acid-stable limit for bulk Ni incorporation in RuO2 is found to be approximately 10 mol%. Ni incorporation affects the rutile structure and inhibits particle growth, while lower synthesis temperatures decrease particle size. The best-performing Ni-doped RuO2 catalyst here shows up to a tenfold increase in OER MA compared with undoped RuO2. Surface area-based normalisation of MA reveals that this enhancement is partly caused by increased accessible surface area and includes an additional contribution from increased intrinsic OER activity. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals Ni-dependent changes in the Ru 3d and O 1s regions (electronic effect), which correlate with the increase in intrinsic OER activity. S-number measurements further indicate an approximately twofold improvement in catalyst stability caused by doping.
items.authors: Mairis Bērziņš, Peeter Valk, Tavo Romann, Priit Möller, Jekaterina Kozlova, Kuno Kooser
items.title_zh: 解耦镍掺杂钌氧化物催化剂的形态与电子效应
items.summary_zh: 本研究以镍掺杂的二氧化钌（Ni-doped RuO2）为模型系统，系统探讨掺杂浓度和合成温度对催化剂形态和电子结构的影响。研究发现，镍的掺入对钌的金红石结构产生影响，并抑制颗粒生长，而较低的合成温度则减小颗粒尺寸。最佳性能的镍掺杂RuO2催化剂的氧气演化反应（OER）质量活性（MA）相比于未掺杂的RuO2提高了十倍。基于比表面积的MA归一化显示，这一增强部分源于可接触表面积的增加，同时也包括了内在OER活性的提升。X射线光电子能谱分析揭示了镍依赖的钌3d和氧1s区域的变化（电子效应），与内在OER活性的增加相关联。

items.title: Catalytic Phosphorus-Based Hydrogen Atom Transfer via a Phosphinoyl Anion Relay
items.abstract: We report the first catalytic phosphorus-based hydrogen atom transfer system. Using an iridium photocatalyst and 10 mol% diphenylphosphine sulfide, we achieve decarboxylative reduction of diverse carboxylic acids—including peptides and pharmaceuticals—to C–H products in up to 95% yield, without stoichiometric reductants. Mechanistic studies reveal an unprecedented anionic relay: a phosphoryl radical is reduced to a phosphinoyl anion, which upon protonation regenerates the P–H catalyst. This work establishes catalytic turnover in phosphorus-based HAT and identifies a new elementary step in main-group radical chemistry.
items.authors: Pratik Avinash, Kayla Merrigan, Bartosz Bieszczad
items.title_zh: 基于磷的催化氢原子转移研究
items.summary_zh: 我们报道了首个基于磷的催化氢原子转移系统。利用铱光催化剂和10 mol%的二苯基膦硫化物，我们实现了多种羧酸（包括肽类和药物）的脱羧还原，C–H产物的产率高达95%，且无需化学计量还原剂。机理研究揭示了一种前所未有的阴离子中继：磷酰自由基被还原为磷酰阴离子，后者在质子化后再生P–H催化剂。这项工作确立了基于磷的HAT催化循环，并识别出主族自由基化学中的新基本步骤。

items.title: From Proteins and Molecules to Cats and Dogs: Visualization as Scalable Minimum Spanning Trees
items.abstract: Dimensionality reduction and data visualization are essential for analyzing highdimensional datasets, yet traditional projection methods obscure local structural relationships. We present TMAP2, a scalable rewrite of TMAP that maps highdimensional data as a minimum spanning tree. TMAP2 accepts diverse input types, including continuous embeddings, sparse fingerprints, and precomputed graphs, and applies to single-cell, image, chemistry, or protein-language-model data. Every line on the map is therefore a real nearest-neighbor relationship, and exactly one path joins any two points. The number of edges along that path, its hop count, works as a coordinate along a progression: it recovers a pancreatic cell’s developmental age (Spearman 0.90), tracks the collection date of a SARS-CoV-2 spike sequence built from raw sequence alone (Spearman 0.86), and traces a smooth morph from a Persian cat to a Yorkshire terrier that crosses species at a single edge. On 3.6 million CAZyme sequences the same tree separates taxonomic domains and, within the family GH43, sorts sequences by catalytic activity, revealing an anchor enzyme annotated as one activity sitting among a cluster of another. TMAP2 extends the original TMAP from fingerprints to any embedding, at up to one million points with 95–99% recall.
items.authors: Alejandro Flores Sepúlveda, Maarten Boneschansker, Jean-Louis Reymond, Daniel Probst
items.title_zh: 从蛋白质到猫狗：可扩展的最小生成树可视化
items.summary_zh: 高维数据集的降维和可视化对于分析至关重要，但传统投影方法常常模糊局部结构关系。我们提出了TMAP2，这是TMAP的可扩展重写，能够将高维数据映射为最小生成树。TMAP2支持多种输入类型，包括连续嵌入、稀疏指纹和预计算图，适用于单细胞、图像、化学或蛋白质语言模型数据。地图上的每一条线都代表真实的最近邻关系，任意两点之间恰好有一条路径。路径上的边数作为进展的坐标，能够恢复胰腺细胞的发育年龄（Spearman 0.90），追踪仅基于原始序列构建的SARS-CoV-2刺突序列的采集日期（Spearman 0.86），并描绘出从波斯猫到约克夏犬的平滑形态变化。在360万个CAZyme序列中，该树分离了分类域，并在GH43家族内按催化活性排序序列，揭示了一个被注释为某种活性的锚定酶与另一簇酶的关系。TMAP2将原始TMAP从指纹扩展到任何嵌入，支持多达一百万个点，召回率达到95-99%。

items.title: What actually moves virtual screening performance: two measured resolution limits and six pre-registered interventions
items.abstract: Reported improvements to structure-based virtual screening are usually differences in AUROC or enrichment between two protocols on one benchmark. We asked what a benchmark of typical size can actually resolve, and then measured six interventions against that limit with the reading rule for each committed to version control before the data existed. Two limits, not one. Scoring the same Vina poses with a second implementation of the same scoring function — agreeing at r = 0.970, no compound differing by more than 2 kcal/mol — moves AUROC by 0.020 [95% CI 0.011, 0.029]. Re-running the whole protocol at a different search effort and scoring it the same way moves AUROC by 0.039 [0.024, 0.056]. The first bounds a comparison of scoring functions on fixed poses; the second bounds a comparison of protocols, which is what most published improvements are. Both fall inside the range in which docking improvements are typically reported. On SARS-CoV-2 Mpro: changing the scoring function on identical poses moved AUROC +0.140, repairing a receptor preparation defect +0.045, scoring the pose ensemble rather than the top pose +0.055, supplying the correct binding site to a co-folding model −0.013, and eight-fold search effort −0.019. Two clear the relevant floor, one is marginal and two fall inside. The sixth — substituting DiffDock-L pose generation — is not evaluable on this panel: DiffDock places a fifth of the compounds outside the binding site, and that fifth is heavier and more often active than the panel, so any comparison on the remainder is biased. These are distributions over cross-validation fold assignment, not point estimates: we previously published the pose-ensemble arm as +0.019 and refuted, and it proved to be the 2nd percentile of a distribution centred at +0.031. The search-effort result is the sharpest either way: its measured effect is smaller than the run-to-run reproducibility of the protocol it was measured in. Docking adds nothing demonstrable over seven free physicochemical descriptors on either panel we assembled: on Mpro it significantly subtracts (−0.002 [−0.004, −0.000]) and on Factor Xa its +0.015 [−0.003, +0.034] crosses zero. Applying the same descriptors to LIT-PCBA gives a median AUROC of 0.7260 across 15 targets against published AutoDock Vina at 0.581 and GNINA at 0.611–0.616. These descriptor baselines are supervised on each benchmark's own labels while docking is not, so this is a bias control in the sense of Sieg et al., not a claim that descriptors are a deployable substitute. On the AVE-debiased variant the descriptor median falls to 0.6510. One method exceeded the floor. Boltz-2, an open-weights co-folding model scoring compounds from sequence and SMILES alone, does not beat the descriptor baseline on its own (Mpro +0.026, Factor Xa +0.019, both intervals spanning zero) but adds +0.093 [+0.062, +0.125] and +0.075 [+0.051, +0.099] respectively when combined with those descriptors. Its advantage is not that it is less property-driven — descriptors explain 63% of its score and 63% of Vina's — but that on Mpro its residual, the part orthogonal to those descriptors, ranks actives at 0.657 where six docking scores residualised the same way sat between 0.494 and 0.573. Both descriptor comparisons are supervised on each target's own labels; transferred cold to the other target the descriptor model ranks actives below chance , and the standalone Boltz-2 score — which requires no labels at all — is the only configuration usable on a target with no known actives. Across twelve cross-validation fold seeds the two do not overlap on Mpro: the highest docking residual observed is 0.581, the lowest Boltz-2 residual 0.644. On Factor Xa the residual result replicates in direction — 0.5882 [0.5789, 0.5975] against that target's own Vina arm at 0.5733 — but the margin is +0.015 rather than +0.083 and the ranges touch at their extremes, so the size of the effect does not replicate. One point outside a band is not a generalisation, so we pre-registered a third scoring approach to test it. FlashBind, an EGNN affinity head over learned docking poses, residualises to 0.538 [0.529, 0.546] — inside the docking band — with all three pre-registered controls passing and a pocket-agreement check ruling out the confound that the band is a property of our docking box. The claim that this ceiling belongs to the scoring approach rather than to these panels therefore remains untested rather than supported.
items.authors: John Goodman
items.title_zh: 虚拟筛选性能的影响因素：两项分辨率极限与六项干预措施
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于结构的虚拟筛选的性能改进，重点分析了典型基准的分辨率限制，并对六项干预措施进行了测量。通过对相同Vina姿势的不同实现进行评分，发现AUROC提高了0.020（95% CI 0.011, 0.029）。在不同搜索努力下重新运行整个协议并以相同方式评分，AUROC提高了0.039（0.024, 0.056）。在SARS-CoV-2 Mpro的研究中，改变相同姿势的评分函数使AUROC提高了0.140，修复受体准备缺陷提高了0.045，评分姿势集合而非最佳姿势提高了0.055，而提供正确结合位点的共折叠模型则降低了0.013，八倍搜索努力降低了0.019。研究结果表明，评分函数和协议比较的改进在典型的对接改进范围内。

items.title: PORMAKE2: Topology-Based Generation of Hypothetical Metal-Organic Frameworks through Single-Metal Nodes and Symmetry-Aware Linker Rotation
items.abstract: Topology-based hypothetical metal–organic framework (MOF) generators enable scalable exploration of chemical space beyond experimentally reported structures, but their accessible design space is constrained by the building blocks and assembly rules they encode. Here, we present PORMAKE2, an upgraded topology-based hypothetical MOF generator designed to improve both access to small-pore structures and geometric fidelity. PORMAKE2 introduces an expanded buildingblock library, including single-metal nodes, and implements symmetry-aware linker rotation for higher-fidelity framework assembly. These upgrades substantially expand the accessible small-pore MOF space and enable MOF designs that were inaccessible to earlier workflows, including ZIF-type and CALF-20-like structures with improved geometrical agreement. Carbon dioxide direct air capture (DAC) and Xenon/Krypton separation are included as case studies demonstrating that improved generator framework can influence downstream screening outcomes. These results establish PORMAKE2 as a more expressive and chemically faithful front-end platform for hypothetical MOF generation.
items.authors: Jungwoo Lee, Younghun Kim, Gunho Lee, Jihan Kim
items.title_zh: PORMAKE2：基于拓扑的假设金属有机框架生成方法
items.summary_zh: 基于拓扑的假设金属有机框架（MOF）生成器能够扩展化学空间的探索，但其设计空间受限于构建模块和组装规则。本文介绍了PORMAKE2，一个升级版的拓扑基础MOF生成器，旨在提高对小孔结构的访问和几何保真度。PORMAKE2引入了扩展的构建模块库，包括单金属节点，并实施了考虑对称性的连接体旋转，以实现更高保真的框架组装。这些升级显著扩展了可访问的小孔MOF空间，并实现了早期工作流程无法获得的MOF设计，包括ZIF型和类似CALF-20的结构，具有更好的几何一致性。作为案例研究，二氧化碳直接空气捕集（DAC）和氙/氪分离展示了改进的生成器框架如何影响后续筛选结果。这些结果确立了PORMAKE2作为一个更具表现力和化学真实感的假设MOF生成前端平台。

items.title: Simulation of Ultrafast Fe(II) Photoswitching Dynamics Triggered by Excitation within the Quintet Manifold
items.abstract: The quintet-to-singlet back-switching process in [Fe(tpy)2]2+(tpy=2,2’:6’,2"-terpyridine), [Fe(dftpy)2]2+ (dftpy=6,6"-difluoro-2,2’:6’,2"-terpyridine) and [Fe(dctpy)2]2+(dctpy=6,6"-dichloro-2,2’:6’,2"-terpyridine), together with the photorelaxation dynamics of the [Fe(dftpy)2]2+ spin-crossover and the [Fe(dctpy)2]2+ high-spin complexes were investigated by full-dimensional trajectory surface hopping (TSH) dynamics. Following photoexcitation, the initial population of the 5Eg (5MC) state decays quickly via a branching mechanism of direct (5Eg → 5T2g) and 3MC-crossed (5Eg → 3MC→5T2g) processes, with the latter dominating the dynamics. The quintet-to-singlet photoconversion, the key step of the back-switching process, remains inefficient ( 10%). This low efficiency arises because the singlet–triplet–quintet crossing region is readily accessible only during the initial sub-picosecond dynamics ( 500 fs). Shifting the crossing region to improve its accessibility could substantially enhance the quintet-to-singlet conversion efficiency, suggesting that more extensive chemical modification could significantly optimize the back-switching process. Upon excitation to the quintet MLCT manifold, the population decays within 200 fs to the dark 5Eg (5MC) state (followed by the relaxation to the 5T2g (5MC) in less than 1 ps); only 1-2% of the initial population remains in the ligand-centered states in all complexes. In contrast, previous transient absorption spectroscopy experiments identified a long-lived 5/7MLCT state for [Fe(dftpy)2]2+ and [Fe(dctpy)2]2+, potentially because the analysis was restricted to picosecond timescales and probe wavelengths were used at which 5MC states are dark.
items.authors: Dániel Buzsáki, György Vankó, Tamás Rozgonyi, Mátyás Pápai
items.title_zh: 超快Fe(II)光开关动力学的模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 本文研究了[Fe(tpy)2]2+、[Fe(dftpy)2]2+和[Fe(dctpy)2]2+中五重态到单重态的反向转换过程，以及[Fe(dftpy)2]2+自旋交叉和[Fe(dctpy)2]2+高自旋复合物的光弛豫动力学，采用全维度轨迹表面跳跃（TSH）动力学方法。光激发后，5Eg（5MC）态的初始种群通过直接（5Eg → 5T2g）和3MC交叉（5Eg → 3MC→5T2g）机制迅速衰减，后者主导了动力学。五重态到单重态的光转化效率较低（约10%），主要由于单重态-三重态-五重态交叉区域仅在初始亚皮秒动力学（约500 fs）期间易于到达。改善交叉区域的可达性可能显著提高五重态到单重态的转化效率，提示更广泛的化学修饰可能显著优化反向转换过程。激发到五重态MLCT态后，种群在200 fs内衰减至暗态5Eg（5MC），随后在不到1 ps内弛豫至5T2g（5MC）；仅1-2%的初始种群保留在配体中心态。

items.title: Synthesis, Spectroscopic Characterisation, and Structural Elucidation of Ni(II) and Cu(II) Complexes of a Novel N,N’-Diaminophthalamidoxime Ligand
items.abstract: A new N,N’-diaminophthalamidoxime (NAD) ligand was synthesised by reacting hydrazine hydrate with diethyl phthalate to give phthalic dihydrazide, which was subsequently reacted with hydroxylamine to yield the target ligand. The ligand was reacted with Ni(II) and Cu(II) salts to give [Ni(NAD)2]Cl2 and [Cu(NAD)2(OAc)2], respectively. The ligand and its complexes were characterised by solubility studies, melting point determination, complexometric metal analysis, room-temperature magnetic susceptibility, and infrared and UV–Visible spectroscopy. The free ligand was soluble in DMSO, DMF and hot ethanol, but insoluble in chloroform, ethyl acetate, acetone, methanol, dichloromethane and distilled water, and all three compounds showed high thermal stability ( 300 °C). Diagnostic infrared bands at 3572 and 3524 cm-1 (νNH2 and νOH) and UV bands at 48,300, 36,630 and 28,985 cm-1 (n→σ*, π→π* and n→π*, respectively) confirmed the identity of the free ligand. Complexometric titration gave experimental metal contents of 9.92% (Cu) and 9.82% (Ni), in good agreement with the theoretical values of 10.09% and 10.15%, consistent with 1:2 metal-to-ligand stoichiometry in both complexes. Coordination through the azomethine nitrogen was indicated by shifts in ν(C=N) to 1651 cm-1 and 1634 cm-1, together with new ν(M–N) bands at 435 cm-1 and 487 cm-1 for the Cu(II) and Ni(II) complexes, respectively. [Ni(NAD)2]Cl2 displayed an effective magnetic moment of 4.83 BM and a d–d transition at 25,000 cm-1, consistent with a high-spin tetrahedral d8 environment, while [Cu(NAD)2(OAc)2] gave a magnetic moment of 2.27 BM and a d–d transition at 15,267 cm-1, consistent with a Jahn–Teller-distorted octahedral d9 environment. Together, these results establish the NAD ligand as an effective bidentate N-donor for first-row transition metal ions.
items.authors: Emmanuel Oluwaseyi Kolawole, Oluwafunmilayo F. Adekunle
items.title_zh: 新型N,N'-二氨基邻苯二甲酰肟配体的Ni(II)和Cu(II)配合物合成及表征
items.summary_zh: 合成了一种新型N,N'-二氨基邻苯二甲酰肟（NAD）配体，通过将水合肼与邻苯二甲酸二乙酯反应生成邻苯二甲酸二肼，随后与羟胺反应得到目标配体。该配体与Ni(II)和Cu(II)盐反应，分别生成[Ni(NAD)2]Cl2和[Cu(NAD)2(OAc)2]。通过溶解度研究、熔点测定、配合物金属分析、室温磁化率以及红外和紫外-可见光谱对配体及其配合物进行了表征。自由配体在DMSO、DMF和热乙醇中可溶，但在氯仿、乙酸乙酯、丙酮、甲醇、二氯甲烷和蒸馏水中不溶，且三种化合物均表现出高热稳定性（300 °C）。红外谱图中3572和3524 cm-1的特征带（νNH2和νOH）及紫外谱图中48,300、36,630和28,985 cm-1的带（n→σ*、π→π*和n→π*）确认了自由配体的身份。配合物的金属含量通过配合滴定实验得到了9.92%（Cu）和9.82%（Ni），与理论值10.09%和10.15%相符，符合1:2金属与配体的化学计量比。配体通过亚胺氮的配位导致ν(C=N)向1651 cm-1和1634 cm-1的偏移，同时Cu(II)和Ni(II)配合物中出现了新的ν(M–N)带，分别位于435 cm-1和487 cm-1。

items.title: Phase-Dependent Thermally Activated Self-Discharge of β-NiOOH and γ-NiOOH Electrodes
items.abstract: Nickel oxyhydroxide electrodes undergo spontaneous self-discharge that is strongly accelerated at elevated temperature. Although detrimental to alkaline batteries, this reaction is central to electrochemical–thermally activated chemical (E‑TAC) water splitting. The process operates in two distinct steps: electrochemical charging of Ni(OH)2 in cold (~25 °C) alkaline electrolyte and hydrogen generation at the cathode, followed by spontaneous regeneration of the charged NiOOH anode in hot (~80–100 °C) alkaline electrolyte, with concurrent oxygen evolution. A key unresolved question is how the charged-phase composition of NiOOH affects this thermally activated self-discharge. Here, we prepare phase-pure cobalt-doped β-NiOOH and γ-NiOOH electrodes using tailored electrochemical charging protocols and compare their short-term self-discharge in hot alkaline electrolyte simulating the TAC step in the E-TAC cycle. X-ray diffraction and iodometric titration show that phase-pure β-NiOOH undergoes little or no measurable structural or oxidation-state change after 5 min in 5 M KOH at 80 or 100 °C. In contrast, phase-pure γ-NiOOH exhibits substantial self-discharge, corresponding to 43-46% of the charge transferred during the preceding charging step, accompanied by partial transformation to α-Ni(OH)2. These results demonstrate that thermally activated self-discharge in charged nickel hydroxide electrodes is strongly phase-dependent under E-TAC-relevant conditions. More broadly, they show that γ-NiOOH, which is usually regarded as an undesirable overcharged phase in alkaline batteries, is closely associated with rapid chemical regeneration and therefore should be considered a key design variable in E-TAC anodes.
items.authors: Elena Praznikov, Avigail Varveri Landman, Avner Rothschild
items.title_zh: β-NiOOH与γ-NiOOH电极的相依赖热激活自放电研究
items.summary_zh: 镍氧氢氧化物电极在高温下会自发自放电，且这一过程在升高温度时显著加速。尽管这一反应对碱性电池有害，但它在电化学-热激活化学（E-TAC）水分解中至关重要。该过程分为两个步骤：在冷却的碱性电解液中对Ni(OH)2进行电化学充电，并在阴极生成氢气，随后在热碱性电解液中自发再生充电的NiOOH阳极，并伴随氧气的释放。我们制备了相纯的钴掺杂β-NiOOH和γ-NiOOH电极，并比较其在模拟E-TAC循环中热碱性电解液中的短期自放电。X射线衍射和碘量法滴定显示，相纯的β-NiOOH在80或100 °C的5 M KOH中经过5分钟后几乎没有可测量的结构或氧化态变化，而相纯的γ-NiOOH则表现出显著的自放电，约占前期充电步骤中转移电荷的43-46%，同时部分转化为α-Ni(OH)2。这些结果表明，充电镍氢氧化物的相组成对热激活自放电有重要影响。

items.title: Temporally decoupled electrochemiluminescence breaks the sensitivity–portability tradeoff in water toxicity sensing
items.abstract: Multiple technologies have been developed to reconcile the trade-off between sensitivity and portability, which is a persistent fundamental challenge in chemical sensing. Among them, electrochemiluminescence (ECL) has the advantages of simple device configuration and outstanding sensitivity based on the transduction of electrochemical signals into optical readouts. However, this is based on multi-step interfacial electron transfer, wherein the concomitant efficiency losses and areadependent signal intensity inherently constitute the primary limitations. Herein, a novel photochargeable wireless ECL (PC-Wireless-ECL) system is established based on a bifunctional carbon nitride (CN). This strategy boosts the ECL signal intensity by eliminating the dependence on the electrode dimensions and decoupling the excitation and emission processes temporally. By constructing portable bifunctional CN vials coupled with a miniaturized light intensity sensor, this system revolutionizes the conventional ECL measurement paradigm and realizes on-site, rapid, and highly sensitive screening of water toxicity, thereby offering a new strategy for next-generation in-field analytical technologies.
items.authors: Chuan Huang, Dan Han, Hong Yang, Kaiqing Wu, Yanfei Shen, Rong Jin
items.title_zh: 时域解耦电化学发光技术打破水毒性检测的灵敏度与便携性权衡
items.summary_zh: 在化学传感中，灵敏度与便携性之间的权衡一直是一个基本挑战。电化学发光（ECL）技术因其简单的设备配置和优异的灵敏度而受到关注，但其依赖于多步界面电子转移，导致效率损失和信号强度的面积依赖性。本文建立了一种基于双功能氮化碳（CN）的新型光充电无线ECL（PC-Wireless-ECL）系统。该策略通过消除对电极尺寸的依赖，并在时间上解耦激发与发射过程，显著增强了ECL信号强度。通过构建便携式双功能CN小瓶并结合微型光强传感器，该系统革新了传统ECL测量范式，实现了水毒性的现场、快速和高灵敏度筛查，为下一代现场分析技术提供了新策略。

items.title: Polyelectrolyte Solutes, Gels, and Coacervates Differentially Impact Proto-Metabolic Ni-Catalyzed Bicarbonate Reduction.
items.abstract: Reactions using metal and mineral catalysis likely provided vital organic feedstocks for the process of life’s origination, accessing early metabolic pathways, building proto-metabolism, and providing avenues for compartmentalization. Towards proto-cellular encapsulation, a growing pool of multiply-charged solutes and polymers, as well as organic-rich phases, would have influenced the operation of Earth’s proto-metabolic pathways. Here, we employ quantitative NMR and model molecules containing relevant carboxylate, amine, and phosphate moieties to describe their effect on the catalytic reduction of bicarbonate to formate, the first step in ancient carbon fixation, such as via a precursor reductive Acetyl-CoA (Wood-Ljungdahl) pathway or reductive tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle. We find that this proto-metabolic carbon fixation process is relatively robust to build-up of organics, maintaining yields within about twofold despite relatively high concentrations of organic additives. Solute effects are not simply predicted by charge or solute size but depend on adsorption, participation in competing reactions, and solute-solute interactions. Combinations of solutes have a nonadditive effect, with certain pairs resulting in unchanged, intermediate, or increased formate yields compared to either solute alone; for example, sequestration of a yield-suppressing co-solute, adenosine monophosphate (AMP), partially alleviates yield suppression.
items.authors: Ella Mullikin, Christopher H. House, Christine D. Keating
items.title_zh: 多电解质溶质、凝胶与共沉淀物对原始代谢的影响
items.summary_zh: 使用金属和矿物催化的反应可能为生命起源过程提供了重要的有机原料，促进了早期代谢途径的形成。本文采用定量核磁共振（NMR）和含有相关羧酸盐、胺和磷酸基团的模型分子，研究其对碳酸氢盐催化还原为甲酸的影响，这是古代碳固定的第一步。研究发现，该原始代谢碳固定过程对有机物的积累相对稳健，尽管有机添加剂浓度较高，产率仍保持在约两倍范围内。溶质的影响不仅由电荷或溶质大小预测，还依赖于吸附、参与竞争反应和溶质间相互作用。溶质组合的效应是非加性的，某些组合导致甲酸产率与单一溶质相比保持不变、中间或增加。

items.title: Development of Improved Liver Steatosis Phantoms for Accurate Histopathologic Representation and Multimodal Imaging
items.abstract: Despite advances in ultrasound-based noninvasive hepatic steatosis quantification, current methods remain insensitive to the microstructural phenotype of lipid accumulation, which influences outcomes in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. A methodology is introduced to generate tissue-mimicking phantom models that replicate the lobular liver histologic structure and pathologic patterns of steatosis. Phantoms consist of packed alginate capsules that mimic liver lobules and maintain continuous inter-capsule contact, embedded in agar. Lipid microparticles of controlled size and concentration are encapsulated within these capsules together with perfluorooctyl bromide microparticles serving as background scatterers. This architecture enables control of microscopic features (lipid vacuole size and density) and macroscopic organization (lobular-scale heterogeneity), both of which are expected to influence quantitative acoustic measurements, thereby more closely reproducing the histologic structure and acoustic behavior of healthy and diseased liver tissue. Phantoms with 0% and 20% fat (weight/volume) exhibit liver-like appearance on B-mode ultrasound imaging, with ultrasound-derived fat fraction and acoustic attenuation correlating with fat content. Chosen constituents enable compatibility with MRI and CT. This platform provides a structurally realistic model to refine and develop ultrasound liver fat quantification techniques and to support cross-vendor standardization, as well as cross-modality validation of ultrasound-based liver fat quantification using MRI and CT.
items.authors: Esther Park, Adam Woodward, Nazia Hafeez, Anbarin Khalid, Shariq Ali, Liqiang Ren
items.title_zh: 改进肝脂肪变性模型的开发以实现准确的组织病理表现和多模态成像
items.summary_zh: 尽管超声基础的非侵入性肝脂肪变性定量方法已有所进展，但当前方法对脂质积累的微观结构表型仍不敏感，这影响了代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病的结果。本文介绍了一种生成组织模拟幻影模型的方法，能够复制肝脏小叶的组织学结构和脂肪变性的病理模式。幻影由填充的海藻酸钠胶囊组成，模拟肝小叶并保持胶囊间的连续接触，嵌入琼脂中。控制大小和浓度的脂质微粒与作为背景散射体的溴化全氟辛烷微粒共同封装在这些胶囊内。这种结构能够控制微观特征（脂质液泡的大小和密度）和宏观组织（小叶尺度的异质性），预计将影响定量声学测量，从而更接近健康和病变肝组织的组织学结构和声学行为。含0%和20%脂肪（重量/体积）的幻影在B模式超声成像中呈现肝脏样外观，超声衍生的脂肪分数和声学衰减与脂肪含量相关。所选成分与MRI和CT兼容。该平台提供了一个结构上真实的模型。

items.title: Reliable Machine Learning for DPPH Antioxidant QSAR: Scaffold- and Study-Aware Validation with an Out-of-Domain Sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly Case Study
items.abstract: Machine-learning QSAR models can prioritize antioxidant compounds, but apparent accuracy depends strongly on how chemical data are partitioned for validation. This study develops a reproducible DPPH antioxidant QSAR workflow using 1,891 curated molecules from a public 30 min DPPH dataset. Molecular structures were represented by nine RDKit physicochemical descriptors and 2,048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius 2), giving 2,057 combined features.Random Forest regression was evaluated as the primary model,with Extra Trees as an independent ensemble comparator.Random Forest achieved mean R-squared = 0.712 and MAE = 0.297 pIC50 units under random five-fold cross-validation, but performance decreased to R-squared = 0.447 and MAE = 0.433 under Bemis-Murcko scaffold-aware validation, and to R-squared = 0.124 and MAE = 0.545 under DOI-grouped validation. In an internal held-out set, molecules with scaffolds represented during training performed better than those with unseen scaffolds(R-squared=0.824 versus 0.580).Nearest-neighbour Morgan Tanimoto analysis further separated structurally supported predictions from extrapolation: inside-domain molecules achieved R-squared = 0.830, whereas outside-domain performance was R- squared =-0.031. The workflow was then applied to two experimentally investigated sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly derivatives. Both had low maximum Tanimoto similarity(0.364 and 0.333), unseen scaffolds,and were overpredicted by approximately one pIC50 unit.The results show that random-split performance alone is insufficient for judging DPPH-QSAR reliability and that chemically informed validation and applicability-domain analysis are necessary when predictions are extended to structurally novel compounds.
items.authors: Dennis Obinna Orji, Ike Ozoemena Christian
items.title_zh: 可靠的机器学习用于DPPH抗氧化QSAR研究
items.summary_zh: 机器学习QSAR模型能够优先筛选抗氧化化合物，但其准确性依赖于化学数据的验证分割方式。本研究开发了一种可重复的DPPH抗氧化QSAR工作流程，使用了来自公共30分钟DPPH数据集的1,891个经过整理的分子。分子结构通过九个RDKit物理化学描述符和2,048位Morgan指纹（半径2）表示，共生成2,057个特征。随机森林回归被评估为主要模型，额外树作为独立的集成比较器。在随机五折交叉验证下，随机森林的平均R平方为0.712，平均绝对误差为0.297 pIC50单位；而在Bemis-Murcko骨架意识验证下，性能下降至R平方0.447和MAE 0.433。在内部保留集上，训练期间出现的骨架分子表现优于未见骨架分子（R平方0.824对比0.580）。最近邻分析进一步区分了结构支持的预测与外推：领域内分子的R平方为0.830，而领域外的表现为R平方-0.031。该工作流程随后应用于两种实验研究的磺胺类-Tyr-Gly衍生物，二者的最大Tanimoto相似度均较低（0.364和0.333）。

items.title: Non-bridging oxygen as the master variable linking structure to the elastic, electronic, and photonic properties of heavy, polarizable cesium silicate glasses
items.abstract: Cesium silicate glasses, (Cs2O)x(SiO2)1−x, are candidate hosts for optical, dielectric and nuclear-waste-immobilization applications, yet the large, polarizable Cs+ cation is poorly described by conventional potentials. We combine a firstprinciples reference with a single, composition-transferable machine-learned force field for the full range x = 0–0.30, built by pooling the ab initio data of all compositions with no empirical parametrization. First-principles calculations show wide-gap insulators whose gap narrows from 5.9 to 3.3 eV, while the static dielectric constant nearly doubles and the refractive index and optical basicity rise, in agreement with experiment. The pooled potential then scales these cells to nanometre-sized glasses, reproducing the density (within ∼2%, and 5% at x = 0.20), the intact SiO4 network, and the bridging-to-non-bridging-oxygen conversion and Qn depolymerization. Its elastic constants agree with Brillouinscattering experiments, and its pair-correlation functions and structure factors match the ab initio reference. A single structural variable, the non-bridging oxygen, governs these trends quantitatively: the moduli decay exponentially to a stiffness floor with a common non-bridging-oxygen scale and the gap narrows linearly with it, making it a quantitative descriptor linking structure to the elastic, electronic and photonic properties and a transferable basis for designing heavy-alkali silicate glasses.
items.authors: Hicham Jabraoui, Yann Vaills, Michael Nolan
items.title_zh: 非桥接氧作为重极化铯硅酸盐玻璃性质的主变量
items.summary_zh: 铯硅酸盐玻璃（(Cs2O)x(SiO2)1−x）是光学、介电和核废料固化应用的候选材料，但传统势能对大且极化的Cs+阳离子的描述较差。我们结合第一性原理参考与单一的、可转移的机器学习力场，覆盖x = 0–0.30的全范围，利用所有成分的从头计算数据构建，无需经验参数化。第一性原理计算显示，这些材料为宽带隙绝缘体，带隙从5.9 eV缩小至3.3 eV，静态介电常数几乎翻倍，折射率和光学碱性上升，与实验结果一致。所构建的势能能够将这些单元扩展到纳米级玻璃，重现密度（误差约2%，在x = 0.20时为5%）、完整的SiO4网络以及桥接氧与非桥接氧的转化和Qn去聚合。其弹性常数与布里渊散射实验一致，配对相关函数和结构因子与从头计算参考匹配。非桥接氧这一单一结构变量定量主导这些趋势：模量以共同的非桥接氧尺度指数衰减至刚度底线，带隙与之线性缩小，使其成为连接结构与弹性、电子及光子性质的定量描述符。

items.title: Unveiling the Potential of Biobased Bifuran unit in Conjugated Polymers: Synthesis, Thermal Properties, Photophysics, and Comparative Study with Phenylene and Thiophene Analogues for OLED Applications
items.abstract: The bifuran unit is an attractive biobased building block for organic electronics, however its potential in electroluminescent devices has not been explored. In this study, a series of bifuranbased conjugated polymers, PBFAr1–PBFAr9, was synthesized via Suzuki–Miyaura polycondensation to evaluate the effect of the bifuran unit on thermal, photophysical, and electrochemical properties. For comparison, analogous polymers containing phenylene (PSPhAr1), biphenyl (PBPhAr1), and bithiophene (PBTAr1) units were also synthesized. Characterization showed that the bifuran-containing polymers exhibit varied thermal stability, emission in both solution and the solid state. Specifically, the photoluminescence quantum yield of chloroform solution of PBFAr1 was 43%, which was higher than the 39% observed for the bithiophene-based analogue, PBTAr1. Kelvin probe measurements indicated an energy-level alignment with the ITO anode that may facilitate hole injection. Solution-processed OLEDs with an ITO/PEDOT:PSS/emissive polymer/LiF/Al architecture were fabricated, and the PBFAr1-based device exhibited bright cyan electroluminescence at 484 nm. These results suggest that bifuranbased conjugated polymers have potential as emissive and p-type semiconducting materials for organic optoelectronic applications.
items.authors: Shekhar Gupta, Yuya Tanaka, Nobuya Hiroshiba, Takeshi Mori, Hitoshi Saomoto, Ryusei Makiko
items.title_zh: 生物基双呋喃单元在共轭聚合物中的潜力研究
items.summary_zh: 双呋喃单元是一种有前景的生物基有机电子材料构建块，但其在电致发光器件中的潜力尚未被探索。本研究合成了一系列基于双呋喃的共轭聚合物PBFAr1–PBFAr9，通过铃木-宫浦聚合评估双呋喃单元对热学、光物理和电化学性质的影响。为比较，还合成了含有苯基（PSPhAr1）、联苯（PBPhAr1）和双噻吩（PBTAr1）单元的类似聚合物。表征结果表明，含双呋喃的聚合物展现出不同的热稳定性，并在溶液和固态中均有发光。特别是，PBFAr1在氯仿溶液中的光致发光量子产率为43%，高于双噻吩基类似物PBTAr1的39%。开尔文探针测量表明其能级与ITO阳极的对齐可能有助于孔注入。制备的ITO/PEDOT:PSS/发光聚合物/LiF/Al结构的OLED中，基于PBFAr1的器件在484 nm处展现出明亮的青色电致发光。这些结果表明，基于双呋喃的共轭聚合物在有机光电应用中具有作为发光和p型半导体材料的潜力。

items.title: Engineering a Carboxylesterase for Acyl Transfer to Amines
items.abstract: Within the mechanistic realm of centralized catalysis (chemical catalysis), reactivity activation is site-centered on reactant functional groups and site-driven from catalytic centers, leading to a low-resolution catalytic architecture with low catalytic activity and catalytic efficiency. In contrast, within the mechanistic realm of decentralized catalysis (biological catalysis), reactivity activation is reactant-spanned on both functional groups and appendage groups and enclosure-driven from catalytic cavity, offering a high-resolution catalytic architecture with high catalytic activity and catalytic efficiency. Herein, as a proof-of-concept illustration for reactant-spanned and enclosure-driven enzymatic catalysis (as exemplary for biological catalysis), we report the engineering of a carboxylesterase for acyl transfer from carboxylesters to amines. The precision disjoint presentation activation of acyl group and amino group has empowered the achievement of an expansive reactant scope of both carboxylesters and amines. As a demonstration of the synthetic utility, a pharmaceutically relevant agent has been constructed on the gram scale. As a manifestation of the synthetic potential, a quantitative or near-quantitative S-enantioselectivity has been established for the kinetic resolution of secondary amines. The high catalytic activity and catalytic efficiency showcased herein promise decentralized catalysis as a powerful, generic mechanistic basis for the highly effective programming of reactivity activation. Keywords: Centralized Catalysis; Decentralized Catalysis; Chemical Catalysis; Biological Catalysis; Carboxylesterase; Acyl Transfer; Carboxylester; Amine; Kinetic Resolution.
items.authors: Wencai Fan, Yue Cheng, Xinxin Liu, Lin Chen, Yaxuan Fang, Wenhui Wang
items.title_zh: 工程化羧酸酯酶实现酰基转移至胺类化合物
items.summary_zh: 在集中催化（化学催化）机制中，反应活化集中于反应物功能团，催化中心驱动，导致催化活性和效率低下。相对而言，在分散催化（生物催化）机制中，反应活化跨越反应物的功能团和附加基团，由催化腔驱动，提供高分辨率的催化架构，具有高催化活性和效率。本研究作为反应物跨越和腔驱动酶催化的概念验证，报道了羧酸酯酶的工程化，以实现羧酸酯向胺的酰基转移。通过精确的酰基和氨基的分离激活，实现了羧酸酯和胺的广泛反应物范围。作为合成实用性的示范，构建了一个药物相关的化合物，规模达到克级。作为合成潜力的体现，建立了对二级胺的动力学分辨率的定量或近定量S-对映选择性。

items.title: Is Bioorthogonal Pretargeting Superior to Conventional Targeted Photosensitizers? A Comparative Study of Chlorin Delivery Using Biotin Vectors
items.abstract: Bioorthogonal pretargeting offers a modular approach to targeted photodynamic therapy (PDT), but its advantages over conventional ligand-photosensitizer conjugates remain insufficiently explored. Here, we aimed to directly compare preformed biotin-containing conjugates with sequential biotin-mediated bioorthogonal delivery. DFT calculations were used to guide the design of new tetrazine dienes with tuned electronic properties for inverse-electron-demand Diels-Alder (IEDDA) chemistry. The selected tetrazines were synthesized and paired with BCN- and s-TCO-functionalized chlorin photosensitizers, and their reactivity was characterized by second-order rate constants and photophysical measurements. In vitro, sequential pretargeting produced substantially higher intracellular fluorescence than administration of preformed 1:1 ligation products; however, this advantage did not translate into enhanced photodynamic activity. Moreover, neither accumulation nor PDT efficacy consistently correlated with SLC5A6 expression in SMVT-high SK-BR-3 versus SMVT-low MDA-MB-231 cells. Free-biotin competition produced heterogeneous, combination-dependent effects, indicating that SMVT is unlikely to be the sole determinant of uptake.
items.authors: Petar Jankovic, Anastasia A. Gorokhova, Ilya A. Shmyrov, Jana M. Svetlova, Natalia S. Kuzmina, Alexander V. Nyuchev
items.title_zh: 生物正交预靶向是否优于传统靶向光敏剂？氯素递送的比较研究
items.summary_zh: 生物正交预靶向为靶向光动力疗法（PDT）提供了一种模块化的方法，但其相对于传统配体-光敏剂结合物的优势尚未充分探讨。本研究直接比较了预制的生物素结合物与顺序生物素介导的生物正交递送。通过密度泛函理论（DFT）计算指导新型四氮唑二烯的设计，以调节其电子性质用于逆电子需求Diels-Alder（IEDDA）反应。合成的四氮唑与BCN和s-TCO功能化的氯素光敏剂配对，其反应性通过二级速率常数和光物理测量进行表征。在体外实验中，顺序预靶向产生的细胞内荧光显著高于预制1:1连接产物的给药；然而，这一优势并未转化为增强的光动力活性。此外，积累量和PDT疗效与SMVT高表达的SK-BR-3细胞与SMVT低表达的MDA-MB-231细胞之间并未一致相关。自由生物素竞争产生了异质的、依赖组合的效应，表明SMVT不太可能是摄取的唯一决定因素。

items.title: A Distributed Diffusion Landscape Governs CO2 Coproduct Release from Fatty Acid Photodecarboxylase
items.abstract: The diffusion of small ligands within proteins is a fundamental yet poorly resolved step in enzymatic turnover.Recent studies have shown that ligand migration can involve networks of transient internal cavities and multiple competing exit routes, raising the question of whether such heterogeneity is a general feature of small-molecule egress.Here, we address this question in fatty acid photodecarboxylase (FAP), a light-driven enzyme that generates CO 2 as a small diffusive coproduct during fatty-acid decarboxylation.Using nine independent classical molecular dynamics simulations of Cv FAP, we show that CO 2 escapes the protein on the µs timescale with kinetics consistent with time-resolved infrared measurements, whereas the alkane product remains bound on the simulated timescale.Before release, CO 2 diffuses through a heterogeneous network of transient cavities, populating several distinct sites before escaping through multiple competing surface exit pathways rather than a single dominant route.One cavity positions CO 2 near C432, consistent with formation of the thiocarbonate intermediate previously identified.CO 2 release is likewise distributed among multiple surface exit points, none corresponding to the water channel observed in the dark-state enzyme.These findings reveal that CO 2 clearance in FAP occurs through an intrinsically heterogeneous diffusion landscape. SignificanceProtein function often depends on the ability of small molecules to move through the protein, but how these molecules find their way out of buried active sites remains poorly understood.Using molecular dynamics simulations of fatty acid photodecarboxylase, we show that CO 2 egress is not governed by a single structural pathway.Instead, CO 2 migrates through a dynamic network of transient cavities and escapes through multiple competing surface routes.The resulting release kinetics are consistent with experimental measurements, linking the heterogeneous diffusion landscape to the observed timescale of CO 2 release.Our findings highlight how protein conformational dynamics can create distributed and multiroute pathways for small-molecule transport, providing an atomistic framework for understanding product egress from enzymes.
items.authors: Gianluca Dell'Orletta, Isabella Daidone
items.title_zh: 分布式扩散景观调控脂肪酸光脱羧酶的CO2副产物释放
items.summary_zh: 小分子配体在蛋白质内的扩散是酶促反应中的一个基本但尚未充分解析的步骤。本研究聚焦于脂肪酸光脱羧酶（FAP），该酶在脂肪酸脱羧反应中生成CO2作为小的扩散副产物。通过九个独立的经典分子动力学模拟，我们发现CO2在微秒时间尺度上从蛋白质中逃逸，其动力学与时间分辨红外测量结果一致，而烷烃产物在模拟时间尺度内保持结合状态。在释放之前，CO2通过一个异质的瞬态腔体网络扩散，经过多个不同的位点后通过多个竞争性表面出口路径逃逸，而非单一主导路径。研究表明，FAP中的CO2释放通过内在异质的扩散景观进行。

items.title: A Metallic Ground State in a Niobium-Pyrazine Coordination Framework
items.abstract: Conductive metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) based on low-valent heavy transition metals remain largely unexplored despite the strong metal-ligand covalency and extended orbitals that should favor electronic delocalization. Herein, we report Nb(pyz) 2 Cl 2 (pyz = pyrazine), a layered coordination framework with a metallic electronic ground state. Although charge transport in pressed pellets is limited by thermally activated grain-boundary hopping, the high room-temperature conductivity of 1.2 S cm⁻ 1 , temperature-independent Pauli susceptibility, finite Sommerfeld coefficient (g = 14.0(5) mJ K⁻ 2 mol⁻ 1 ), Wilson ratio close to unity, and periodic density functional theory calculations consistently demonstrate a finite density of states at the Fermi level. X-ray absorption spectroscopy further reveals a strongly delocalized electronic structure involving mixed Nb 4d, Cl 3p, and pyz p* states. These results identify low-valent early-4d ions as promising components for electronically delocalized coordination solids and extend metallic metal-organic frameworks beyond the 3d transition-metal series.
items.authors: Michał Magott, Dominik Dzierżek, Katia Dujarric, Pierre Dechambenoit, Mathieu Rouzières, Gabriela Handzlik
items.title_zh: 铌-吡嗪配位框架中的金属基态研究
items.summary_zh: 基于低价重过渡金属的导电金属有机框架（MOFs）尚未得到充分探索，尽管金属-配体共价性强且轨道延展性有利于电子去局域化。本文报道了Nb(pyz)₂Cl₂（pyz = 吡嗪），一种具有金属电子基态的层状配位框架。尽管在压制颗粒中的电荷传输受到热激活的晶界跳跃限制，但其在室温下的高导电性为1.2 S cm⁻¹，温度无关的保利磁化率，有限的索末菲系数（g = 14.0(5) mJ K⁻² mol⁻¹），接近于1的威尔逊比，以及周期性密度泛函理论计算一致表明费米能级处存在有限的态密度。X射线吸收光谱进一步揭示了涉及混合的Nb 4d、Cl 3p和pyz p*态的强去局域化电子结构。这些结果表明低价早期4d离子是电子去局域化配位固体的有前景成分，并将金属有机框架的研究扩展至3d过渡金属系列之外。

items.title: Deployability-First Benchmarking of LFIA Innovation: A Framework and COVID-19 Literature Audit
items.abstract: Lateral flow immunoassays (LFIAs) are operationally simple, enabling low-barrier, decentralized testing. Their reported performance should therefore be interpreted in relation to the deployability of the required workflow. LFIA innovations often seek improved detection performance, commonly expressed as lower limits of detection (LODs), but workflows can differ substantially in burden and testing conditions. To guide experimental planning, interpretation of results, and formulation of performance claims, we developed a deployability-first benchmarking framework. At the planning stage, the intended deployment setting guides selection of a compatible workflow, while the performance question guides the type of evidence needed to address it. The framework distinguishes low-burden, enhanced lowburden, and higher-burden workflows. Once results are available, the implemented workflow, sample context, measured endpoint, LOD definition, and any comparator help determine what conclusions and comparisons are supported and how the claim should be framed. We applied these principles retrospectively to 96 COVID-19 LFIA innovation articles. Nearly two-thirds of workflows supporting the selected primary performance claims were higher-burden, requiring instrumentation, trained users, or laboratory conditions. Direct like-with-like benchmarking was often limited by differences in workflow burden, sample context, endpoint, LOD definition, readout mode, and comparator conditions. We operationalized result interpretation and claim framing as a claim-level checklist. Applied retrospectively to the same 96 selected primary claims, about 40% were supported as written, whereas about 60% required narrowing or reframing. COVID-19 served as a literature test case; the framework and checklist contain no COVID-19-specific criteria and were designed for medical and non-medical LFIA settings.
items.authors: Sergey N. Krylov, Xingzhi Che, Jeffrey Azzi, Svetlana M. Krylova, Nima Tabatabaei, Laura Anfossi
items.title_zh: 基于可部署性的LFIA创新基准评估框架及COVID-19文献审计
items.summary_zh: 侧向流免疫测定（LFIA）因其操作简单，支持低门槛的分散式检测。LFIA创新通常追求更好的检测性能，常以更低的检测限（LOD）表示，但工作流程在负担和检测条件上可能存在显著差异。为指导实验规划、结果解读和性能声明的制定，我们开发了一个以可部署性为首的基准评估框架。在规划阶段，预期的部署环境指导兼容工作流程的选择，而性能问题则指导所需证据的类型。该框架区分了低负担、增强低负担和高负担工作流程。结果显示，96篇COVID-19 LFIA创新文章中，近三分之二的工作流程为高负担，需使用仪器、训练有素的用户或实验室条件。直接的同类基准评估常因工作流程负担差异而受限。

items.title: The Role of In Situ Crosslinked Polysiloxane/Polylactide Micro-Networks on the PLA Brittle-Ductile Transition
items.abstract: Polylactide (PLA) has garnered significant attention as a potentially sustainable substitute for conventional petrochemical polymers. This attention is attributed to several factors, including its renewable origin, biodegradability, and its compatibility with conventional polymer processing techniques. However, its inherent fragility restricts its broader utilization as an engineering plastic. In this study, the investigation focused on the thermally activated reactive modification of PLA with two functional polysiloxanes of varying molecular architectures. This modification was explored as a toughening strategy, with the objective of promoting the brittle-to-ductile (BD) transition through the formation of a locally entangled polysiloxane/PLA micro-network within the PLA matrix. Extraction, thermal, spectroscopic, and morphological analyses were conducted to confirm the formation of a crosslinked phase. The micromechanical deformation mechanisms of pristine and toughened PLA under tension, bending, and impact forces are discussed, revealing that the dispersion level, size of dispersed phase, molecular weight, and reactivity of the introduced soft phase strongly influence rheological and mechanical performance, leading to markedly improved mechanical performance. For instance, impact strength reaches ∼37 kJ/m2 at 1 wt% MOD1 and elongation at break increases to 90% at 5 wt% MOD2.
items.authors: Julia Głowacka, Roksana Konieczna, Daria Pakuła, Miłosz Frydrych, Bogna Sztorch, Kosma Szutkowski
items.title_zh: 原位交联聚硅氧烷/聚乳酸微网络在PLA脆韧转变中的作用
items.summary_zh: 聚乳酸（PLA）因其可再生来源、生物降解性及与传统聚合物加工技术的兼容性而受到广泛关注。然而，其固有的脆性限制了其作为工程塑料的广泛应用。本研究探讨了通过两种不同分子结构的功能性聚硅氧烷对PLA进行热激活反应性改性，以促进PLA中的脆韧转变。通过提取、热分析、光谱分析和形态学分析确认了交联相的形成。讨论了原料PLA和改性PLA在拉伸、弯曲和冲击力下的微观力学变形机制，结果表明，分散程度、分散相大小、分子量及引入软相的反应性对流变和机械性能有显著影响，机械性能显著提高。例如，在1 wt% MOD1时冲击强度达到约37 kJ/m²，5 wt% MOD2时断裂伸长率增加至90%。

items.title: Morphology-Dependent Excited-State Dynamics in Hollow Sphere Poly(Heptazine Imide) Photocatalysts
items.abstract: Photocatalytic oxygen reduction to hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) over stable, earthabundant materials is attractive for solar energy conversion. The question how photocatalyst morphology governs photocatalytic performance remains, however, poorly understood, as the contributions of surface area and charge-carrier dynamics are convoluted. Herein, we investigate a series of hard-templated hollow potassium poly(heptazine imide) (PHI) spheres (KPHIS) with varying shell thickness and porosity. The photocatalytic H2O2 production is benchmarked against bulk KPHI and correlated with excited-state dynamics probed by steadystate and time-resolved photoluminescence and femtosecond transient absorption spectroscopy under quencher-free and donor-containing conditions. Notably, whilst all KPHIS outperform bulk KPHI, the activity varies non-monotonically with shell thickness and excitation wavelength, whereby the thickest-shelled sphere ‒ not the one with the highest specific surface area and pore volume ‒ is most active at 365 and 406 nm, with apparent quantum yields up to ~3.9%. These experiments reveal that the activity is governed not by porosity alone but by the kinetic competition between donor-mediated hole extraction (least efficient in the most porous sample at low wavelength irradiation) and stabilization of long-lived reduced states that drive O2 reduction. Shell thickness should be co-optimized with light penetration depth and donorconditioned charge dynamics, rather than maximizing porosity alone.
items.authors: Alexander Lange, Lingli Ni, Arindam Konar, Andreas Stihl, Dariusz Mitoraj, Marius Hermesdorf
items.title_zh: 空心球聚（七嗪酰亚胺）光催化剂的形态依赖激发态动力学
items.summary_zh: 稳定且丰富的材料在光催化氧还原生成过氧化氢（H2O2）方面具有吸引力，但光催化剂形态如何影响其性能仍不清楚。本研究探讨了一系列硬模板空心钾聚（七嗪酰亚胺）（KPHIS）球体，具有不同的壳厚和孔隙率。通过稳态和时间分辨光致发光及飞秒瞬态吸收光谱，在无淬灭剂和含供体条件下，评估了光催化H2O2的生成与激发态动力学的关系。结果显示，所有KPHIS的性能均优于块体KPHI，但活性随壳厚和激发波长呈非单调变化，最厚壳球体在365和406 nm处表现出最高活性，量子产率可达约3.9%。这些实验表明，活性不仅受孔隙率影响，还受到供体介导的孔提取与长寿命还原态稳定化之间的动力学竞争的影响。

items.title: Interface-Engineered MXene/TMD Heterostructures for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution: Progress, DFT-Guided Mechanisms, and Perspectives
items.abstract: The hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) requires efficient, durable, and earth-abundant electrocatalysts to reduce reliance on platinum-group metals. MXene/transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures offer a promising platform by combining the abundant, tunable catalytic sites of TMDs with the high electrical conductivity, hydrophilicity, and versatile surface chemistry of MXenes. This review critically examines recent advances in the synthesis, interfacial engineering, and HER performance of MXene/TMD heterostructures, with particular emphasis on how interfacial interactions govern catalytic behavior. The roles of phase engineering, defect and heteroatom incorporation, surface terminations, and heterointerface construction are discussed in relation to interfacial charge redistribution, electronic-structure modulation, hydrogen adsorption energetics, active-site accessibility, and reaction kinetics. Experimental HER performance across representative MXene/TMD systems is compared to establish structure-interface-performance relationships and identify the origins of enhanced activity and stability. Particular attention is given to density functional theory (DFT) as a mechanistic tool for resolving heterostructure stability, interfacial charge transfer, electronic structure, and hydrogen adsorption free energy (ΔGH*). The review also assesses limitations in current computational descriptions of electrocatalytic interfaces, including solvent and electrolyte effects, potential-dependent surface charging, dynamic surface reconstruction, and the accuracy of commonly used exchange-correlation functionals. By integrating experimental observations with theoretical insights, this review identifies interfacial electronic coupling and local active-site chemistry as central determinants of HER performance, while highlighting oxidation stability, interfacial reproducibility, realistic electrochemical modeling, and scalable fabrication as persistent challenges. Finally, future directions combining controlled interfacial synthesis, operando characterization, and advanced constant-potential and solvent-inclusive simulations are proposed to accelerate the development of efficient and durable MXene/TMD electrocatalysts for green hydrogen production.
items.authors: Sana Akir, Sajjad Ali, Levna Chacko, Amutha Subramani, Qaisar Alam, Zdeněk Sofer
items.title_zh: 界面工程化MXene/TMD异质结构用于高效氢气演化反应
items.summary_zh: 氢气演化反应（HER）需要高效、耐用且丰富的电催化剂，以减少对铂族金属的依赖。MXene/过渡金属二硫化物（TMD）异质结构通过结合TMD的丰富可调催化位点与MXene的高电导率、亲水性和多样化表面化学，提供了一个有前景的平台。本文回顾了MXene/TMD异质结构的合成、界面工程和HER性能的最新进展，重点讨论了界面相互作用如何影响催化行为。探讨了相工程、缺陷和异原子掺入、表面终止及异质界面构建在界面电荷重分布、电子结构调制、氢吸附能量、活性位点可及性和反应动力学中的作用。通过比较代表性MXene/TMD体系的实验HER性能，建立了结构-界面-性能关系，并识别出增强活性和稳定性的来源。特别关注密度泛函理论（DFT）作为解析异质结构稳定性、界面电荷转移、电子结构和氢吸附自由能（ΔGH*）的机制工具。

items.title: Machine Learning Optimization of Polymeric Complex Coacervate Micelles Reveals Cell-Type-Specific Formulations for Enhanced mRNA Delivery
items.abstract: The cell-type dependent transfection heterogeneity of polymeric mRNA delivery remains a fundamental barrier to their broad translation. The field has historically addressed this by optimizing the cationic component itself, refining amine identity, density, and block architecture to maximize transfection. Even highly optimized cationic carriers, however, still transfect some cell types well and others poorly, because no single cation chemistry can simultaneously match the internalization and cytoplasmic trafficking biology of every target. Rather than seeking a universally optimal carrier chemistry, we instead sought a tunable formulation framework capable of adapting charge balance and interfacial properties across distinct cellular environments. Here, we report a multicomponent complex coacervate micelle platform in which a cationic oligoamine-functionalized A7 amphiphile , an anionic poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (CEA) homopolymer, and a neutral-anionic poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (PEG-CEA) diblock are co-assembled into a single carrier, with the anionic and stealth components associating electrostatically with the cationic micelle as external corona species. Closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization (qNEHVI) of the A7/CEA/PEG-CEA formulation simplex over three rounds in HEK293T cells identified a productive ternary region that increased effective efficiency (delivery × viability) from ~0.35 for the A7 homomicelle to approximately 0.8 for the best mixed micelle. The resulting 35-formulation library was directly screened across six additional cell types (A549, MDA-MB-231, HuH7, OVCAR8, HEK001, and primary patient-derived fibroblasts), where the best mixed micelle outperformed all polymer-based commercial reagents in every cell line. The winning composition was different in every cell line, establishing tunability rather than a single fixed optimum as the platform's central practical advantage. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) attribution on Random Forest surrogates then converted these cell-line-specific winners into transferable design rules, identifying which formulation descriptors drive delivery and viability in each cellular context. Together, this work delivers a tunable polymeric transfection platform and a framework for cell-type-aware design of mRNA carriers.
items.authors: Sidharth Panda, Theresa M. Reineke
items.title_zh: 聚合物复合相分离胶束的机器学习优化及其mRNA递送应用
items.summary_zh: 聚合物mRNA递送的细胞类型依赖性转染异质性是其广泛应用的基本障碍。传统上，通过优化阳离子成分来解决这一问题，但即使是高度优化的阳离子载体在不同细胞类型中的转染效果仍存在差异。我们提出了一种可调配方框架，能够在不同细胞环境中适应电荷平衡和界面特性。本文报告了一种多组分复合相分离胶束平台，其中阳离子寡胺功能化的A7表面活性剂、阴离子聚（羧乙基丙烯酸）(CEA)均聚物和中性-阴离子聚（乙烯醇）-b-聚（羧乙基丙烯酸）(PEG-CEA)二嵌段共聚物共同组装成单一载体。通过对A7/CEA/PEG-CEA配方的闭环多目标贝叶斯优化，识别出在HEK293T细胞中有效的三元区域。

items.title: Melt-State Ligand Addition Generates a Near-Infrared-Emissive Coordination Polymer Glass
items.abstract: Meltable coordination polymers (CPs) combine liquid-phase processability with the structural and functional diversity of crystalline coordination compounds, but methods to install targeted local coordination environments and photophysical functions in CP glasses remain limited. Here, we demonstrate that 1,10-phenanthroline (phen) reacts with the 1D-extended Cu I -CP Cu(ipim) (Cuip; ipim − = 2-isopropylimidazolate) in the melt, converting half of the linearly coordinated Cu I sites into pseudo-tetrahedral [Cu(phen)(ipim) 2 ] − units while preserving chain topology and the interchain-separation melting mechanism. Depending on thermal history, the resulting phen 0.5 Cuip forms either a melt-quenched glass or crystalline polymorphs, whereas pristine Cuip invariably recrystallizes on cooling. X-ray total scattering and spectroscopic analyses show that the local Cu I -phen motif is retained across the phases, while the coordination geometry, interchain order, and phen···phen π-stacking interactions differ. Ligand addition transforms the photophysics from green phosphorescence in Cuip to broad near-infrared emission centered at approximately 850 nm in both crystalline and glassy phen 0.5 Cuip. The pronounced temperature dependence of this emission is consistent with a thermally activated delayed fluorescence mechanism. Calculations indicate that the extended CP environment restricts flattening of the pseudo-tetrahedral [Cu(phen)(ipim) 2 ] − units after metal-to-ligand charge-transfer (MLCT) excitation, thereby limiting access to non-radiative decay pathways. Melt-state ligand addition thus provides a route to construct molecular-complex-like functional units during processing, linking reactive CP melt chemistry to targeted photophysical design in CP glasses.
items.authors: Jan-Benedikt Weiß, Michael Nuss, Taichi Nishiguchi, Zichong Yu, Giulia Rosano, Ellan K. Berdichevsky
items.title_zh: 熔融态配体添加生成近红外发射配位聚合物玻璃
items.summary_zh: 熔融可加工的配位聚合物（CPs）结合了液相加工性与晶体配位化合物的结构和功能多样性，但在CP玻璃中安装特定局部配位环境和光物理功能的方法仍然有限。本文展示了1,10-菲啰啉（phen）与一维扩展的Cu I -CP Cu(ipim)（Cuip；ipim− = 2-异丙基咪唑盐）在熔融状态下反应，将一半线性配位的Cu I位点转化为伪四面体[Cu(phen)(ipim)2]−单元，同时保持链拓扑和链间分离的熔融机制。根据热历史，生成的phen0.5Cuip形成熔融淬火玻璃或晶体多形体，而原始Cuip在冷却时则不可避免地重结晶。X射线全散射和光谱分析表明，局部Cu I -phen结构在不同相中保持不变，但配位几何、链间有序性和phen···phen π-堆叠相互作用有所不同。配体添加使得光物理特性从Cuip中的绿色磷光转变为在晶体和玻璃态的phen0.5Cuip中约850 nm的宽近红外发射。该发射的明显温度依赖性与热激活延迟荧光机制一致。计算表明，扩展的CP环境限制了f。

items.title: Effects due to the solvent density distribution on the dynamics of polymer coils in solution under rheological flow fields
items.abstract: We study the behaviour of highly resolved polymer chains under rheological flow fields encompassing varying levels of hydrodynamic interactions (HI) using dissipative particle dynamics (DPD) simulations. The chains are discretized to a single Kuhn step, while the spring lengths set the level of HI. While the overall trends agree with Brownian dynamics (BD) simulations of similarly resolved chains, the balance of drag and restoring spring forces is unable to explain the chain stretch obtained for DPD simulations with higher HI (lower spring length) at moderately large flow rates. For compact coils showing high levels of HI in DPD simulations, the solvent density remains low deep inside the coil, which persists to some extent even as the chains stretch at higher flow rates. In contrast, the solvent density remains nearly constant, at the bulk value, across expanded coils with larger spring lengths. We show how this density distribution has implications for the viscosity of the interface between the polymer coil and solvent and provides a correction to the viscosity used in the drag force expression, which explains the chain stretch values observed in simulations. CFD simulations show the decay of the influence of one sphere on another beyond a separation of one diameter and the persistence of the same for a linear array of spheres, which allows the assumption of a thin cylinder for the drag force.
items.authors: Sanjay Jana, Rishi Kumar, S V Sivakrishna, Bharatkumar Sharma, Indranil Saha Dalal
items.title_zh: 溶剂密度分布对聚合物链在流动场中动力学的影响
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了在流变流场下高分辨率聚合物链的行为，采用耗散粒子动力学（DPD）模拟，涵盖不同水平的流体动力学相互作用（HI）。链条被离散为单个库恩步长，弹簧长度设定了HI的水平。尽管整体趋势与类似分辨率链的布朗动力学（BD）模拟一致，但拖曳力与恢复弹簧力的平衡无法解释在中等流速下DPD模拟中获得的链条拉伸。对于在DPD模拟中显示出高HI的紧凑卷曲，溶剂密度在卷曲内部保持较低，即使在较高流速下链条拉伸时仍然存在一定程度的保持。相比之下，扩展卷曲的溶剂密度几乎保持恒定，接近体积值。我们展示了这种密度分布对聚合物卷曲与溶剂界面的粘度的影响，并提供了对拖曳力表达式中使用的粘度的修正，解释了模拟中观察到的链条拉伸值。CFD模拟显示，一个球体对另一个球体的影响在分离超过一个直径后衰减，并且在球体的线性阵列中保持相同的影响，这允许假设为细长圆柱体。

items.title: Unlocking Ligand-Centered Redox Activity in an Indenyl Framework through Phosphorus Substitution
items.abstract: Herein, we show that a phosphonium-substituted diphosphaindenylide (PPIPh) functions as a genuine two-electron redox-active π-ligand. The cationic manganese complex [Mn(CO)3(η5‑PPIPh)][BArF24] ([1][BArF24]) undergoes a reversible two-electron reduction to afford the isolable anionic complex [K(18c6)][Mn(CO)3(η3‑PPIPh)]·([K(18c6)][BArF24])n (n = 1 – 5). This constitutes the first isolable and structurally characterized two-electron redox couple of an indenyl-derived manganese complex, which has previously eluded isolation with purely carbocyclic indenyl ligands. Computational studies establish manganese in the +I oxidation state in both complexes, demonstrating that the redox process is exclusively ligand-centered. The redox-activity of the ligand also translates into chemical reactivity, with the anionic complex affording 91% yield in the hydroboration of 2-acetonaphthone, compared to only 7% for [1][BArF24].
items.authors: David Zuber, Michael Neuwirt, Peter Coburger
items.title_zh: 通过磷替代解锁茂基框架中的配体中心氧化还原活性
items.summary_zh: 本研究展示了一种磷鎓取代的二磷茂基化合物（PPIPh）作为真正的双电子氧化还原活性π-配体。阳离子锰复合物[Mn(CO)3(η5‑PPIPh)][BArF24]（[1][BArF24]）经历可逆的双电子还原，生成可分离的阴离子复合物[K(18c6)][Mn(CO)3(η3‑PPIPh)]·([K(18c6)][BArF24])n（n = 1 – 5）。这是首个可分离且结构表征的茂基衍生锰复合物的双电子氧化还原对，以前仅用纯碳环茂基配体未能实现。计算研究表明，两种复合物中的锰均为+I氧化态，证明了氧化还原过程完全是配体中心的。配体的氧化还原活性也转化为化学反应性，阴离子复合物在2-乙酰萘的氢硼化反应中获得91%的产率，而[1][BArF24]仅为7%。

items.title: Advanced HILIC-MS Analysis of Therapeutic siRNAs with Non-Canonical Backbones and Conjugate Scaffolds
items.abstract: The evolution of small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutics toward increasingly complex chemical architecture has created analytical challenges for structural characterization. Confident sequencing and site-specific localization of modifications by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) remain difficult due to non-canonical backbone chemistry, diverse chemical modifications and attached conjugates, all contributing to heterogeneous fragmentation. We present an ion-pair-free hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (HILIC–MS/MS) workflow that enables non-denaturing and denaturing analysis of conjugated, heavily modified siRNA constructs through temperature-controlled separation. Under non-denaturing conditions, duplexes can be evaluated to assess therapeutic integrity and stability, whereas elevated temperatures achieve duplex dissociation, permitting chromatographic separation and MS/MS analysis of sense and antisense strands. The method was benchmarked using multiple siRNA therapeutics of increasing structural complexity, including the unconjugated duplex ATU027, patisiran, a Huntingtin (HTT)-targeting siRNA containing an extended nucleic acid (exNA) backbone, and a GalNAc-conjugated siRNA drug, fitusiran. Complementary activation methods, including collision-induced dissociation (CID), higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD), and ultraviolet photodissociation (UVPD), produced extensive backbone fragmentation and high sequence coverage while also revealing conjugate-specific fragmentation pathways for GalNAc siRNA. Customized Nucleo-SAFARI software supported confident localization of chemical modifications, non-canonical backbone chemistries, and conjugation sites. These results establish temperature-controlled HILIC–MS/MS as a versatile analytical framework for robust structural characterization of complex therapeutic siRNAs.
items.authors: Mohamed I. Gadallah, Noha M El Zahar, Thanh Nguyen, Michael B. Lanzillotti, Kailyn L. Nonhof, Nicholas McHugh
items.title_zh: 非典型骨架和结合支架的治疗性siRNA的高级HILIC-MS分析
items.summary_zh: 小干扰RNA（siRNA）治疗的发展使其化学结构日益复杂，给结构表征带来了分析挑战。由于非典型骨架化学、各种化学修饰和附加结合物导致的异质性碎片化，使得通过串联质谱（MS/MS）进行自信的测序和特定位点修饰定位仍然困难。我们提出了一种无离子对的亲水性相互作用液相色谱-质谱（HILIC-MS/MS）工作流程，能够通过温控分离对结合的、重修饰的siRNA构建体进行非变性和变性分析。在非变性条件下，可以评估双链的治疗完整性和稳定性，而在高温下实现双链解离，允许对正义链和反义链进行色谱分离和MS/MS分析。该方法通过多种结构复杂性逐渐增加的siRNA治疗药物进行了基准测试，包括未结合的双链ATU027、patisiran、含扩展核酸（exNA）骨架的Huntingtin（HTT）靶向siRNA，以及GalNAc结合的siRNA药物fitusiran。

items.title: BigMixSolDB: Extraction of a solubility database in solvent mixtures with an uncertainty-quantified large language model-based pipeline
items.abstract: The rapidly expanding body of chemical literature contains physical data scattered across unstructured text and complex tables in thousands of publications. Translating this information into machine-readable formats is essential for training data-driven chemical models. The lack of uncertainty quantification in computationally extracted datasets makes manual extraction and curation still necessary. We here address this challenge and present an uncertainty-quantified data extraction pipeline. Our fully automated pipeline utilizes large language models (LLMs) to extract complex tabular and textual chemical data directly from scientific PDFs.
